How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into image object.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 NSString *input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 2.jpg image.
 FSFileSpec *filespec_jpg = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_jpg.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_jpg.fileName = @"2.jpg";
 filespec_jpg.description = @"jpeg";
 [filespec_jpg embed:[input_path stringByAppendingString:@"2.jpg"]];
 filespec_jpg.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 2.jpg with image object.
 {
 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeImage];
 FSImageObject *image_object = [[page getGraphicsObject:position] getImageObject];
 if (image_object != nil) {
 [associated_files associateFileWithImageObject:image_object file_spec:filespec_jpg];

 FSFileSpec *filespec_image_object = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:[[image_object getStream] getDictionary] index:0];
 [filespec_image_object exportToFile:@"image_x_object.jpg"];
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add check box form field.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddCheckBoxForm(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Add check box
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Check Box0" field_type:FSFieldTypeCheckBox rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50.0 bottom1:650 right1:90 top1:690]];
 [control setChecked:YES];
 FSWidget *widget = [control getWidget];
 widget.mKBorderColor = 0x000000;
 widget.mKBackgroundColor = 0xFFFFFF;
 [widget resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add check box.");
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Create a blank new page and add check box form.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];

 AddCheckBoxForm(page, form);

 NSString *newPdf = @"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a squiggly annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add squiggly annotation.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:200 bottom1:450 right1:300 top1:550];
 FSSquiggly* squiggly = [[FSSquiggly alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotSquiggly rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [squiggly setFlags:4];
 [squiggly setIntent:@"Squiggly"];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:210 y:500];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:290 y:500];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:210 y:480];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:290 y:480];
 quad_points.fourth = point;
 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];
 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 [squiggly setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];
 [squiggly setSubject:@"Squiggly"];
 [squiggly setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [squiggly setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [squiggly setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [squiggly setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [squiggly resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a squiggly annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to search text in all pages in PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void OutputMatchedInfo(NSMutableString *log, FSTextSearch *search, int matched_index) {
	int page_index = [search getMatchPageIndex];
	NSLog(:@"Index of matched pattern:\t%d\n", matched_index);
	NSLog(:@"\tpage:\t%d\n", page_index);
	NSLog(:@"\tmatch char start index:\t%d\n", [search getMatchStartCharIndex]);
	NSLog(:@"\tmatch char end index:\t%d\n", [search getMatchEndCharIndex]);
	NSLog(:@"\tmatch sentence start index:\t%d\n", [search getMatchSentenceStartIndex]);
	NSLog(:@"\tmatch sentence:\t%@\n", [search getMatchSentence]);

	FSRectFArray *rects = [search getMatchRects];
	int rect_count = [rects getSize];
	NSLog(:@"\tmatch rectangles count:\t%d\n", rect_count);
	for (int i = 0; i < rect_count; i++) {
 FSRectF *rect = [rects getAt:i];
 NSLog(:@"\trectangle(in PDF space) :%d\t[left = %.4f, bottom = %.4f, right = %.4f, top = %.4f]\r\n", i, rect.left, rect.bottom, rect.right, rect.top);
	}
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", input_file, (int)code);
 return 1;
 }

 NSMutableString *log = @"".mutableCopy;

 // sample 1: search for all pages of doc.
 FSTextSearch *search = [[FSTextSearch alloc] initWithDocument:doc cancel:nil flags:(int)FSTextPageParseTextNormal];
 int startIndex = 0;
 int endIndex = [doc getPageCount] - 1;
 [search setStartPage:startIndex];
 [search setEndPage:endIndex];
 NSString *pattern = @"Foxit";
 [search setPattern:pattern];
 NSInteger flags = FSTextSearchSearchNormal;
 [search setSearchFlags:(unsigned int)flags];
 NSLog(@"Begin search %@ at %@.\n", pattern, input_file);
 NSLog(@"Start index:\t%d\n", startIndex);
 NSLog(@"End index:\t%d\n", endIndex);
 NSLog(@"Match key:\t%@\r\n", pattern);
 NSLog(@"Match case:\t%@\n", (flags & FSTextSearchSearchMatchCase ? @"Yes" : @"No"));
 NSLog(@"Match whole word:\t%@\n", (flags & FSTextSearchSearchMatchWholeWord ? @"Yes" : @"No"));
 NSLog(@"Consecutive:\t%@\n", (flags & FSTextSearchSearchConsecutive ? @"Yes" : @"No"));

 int match_count = 0;
 while ([search findNext]) {
 OutputMatchedInfo(log, search, match_count);
 match_count ++;
 }
 if (![[log dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] writeToFile:output_file atomically:YES]) {
 NSLog(@"cann't write log to %@.", output_file);
 }
 NSLog(@"Matched %d counts.", match_count);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add list box form field.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddInteractiveForms(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {

 // Add list box
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"List Box0" field_type:FSFieldTypeListBox rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50.0 bottom1:450 right1:350 top1:500]];
 FSField *field = [control getField];
 FSChoiceOptionArray *options = [[FSChoiceOptionArray alloc] init];
 [options add:[[FSChoiceOption alloc] initWithOption_value:@"Foxit SDK" option_label:@"Foxit SDK" selected:YES default_selected:YES]];
 [options add:[[FSChoiceOption alloc] initWithOption_value:@"Foxit Reader" option_label:@"Foxit Reader" selected:YES default_selected:YES]];
 [options add:[[FSChoiceOption alloc] initWithOption_value:@"Foxit Phantom" option_label:@"Foxit Phantom" selected:YES default_selected:YES]];
 field.options = options;

 FSWidget *widget = [control getWidget];
 widget.mKBorderColor = 0x000000;
 widget.mKBackgroundColor = 0xFFFFFF;
 [widget resetAppearanceStream];
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Create a blank new page and insert list box form field.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 AddInteractiveForms(page, form);
 NSString *newPdf = @"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"Foxit.bmp";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 FSBitmap *flip_bitmap = [bitmap flip:YES is_flip_vert:YES];
 output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", @"flip_horz_vert_Foxit.bmp"];
 saveBitmap(flip_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to create a PDF document insert the image objects into the created PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddImageObjects(FSPDFPage *page, NSString *image_file) {
 long position = [page getLastGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeImage];
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:image_file];
 FSImageObject *image_object = [FSImageObject create:[page getDocument]];
 [image_object setImage:image frame_index:0];

 float width = [image getWidth];
 float height = [image getHeight];

 float page_width = [page getWidth];
 float page_height = [page getHeight];

 // Please notice the matrix value.
 image_object.matrix = [[FSMatrix2D alloc] initWithA1:width b1:0 c1:0 d1:height e1:(page_width - width) / 2.0f f1:(page_height - height) / 2.0f];

 [page insertGraphicsObject:position graphics_object:image_object];
 [page generateContent];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"graphics_objects.pdf";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Add a new PDF page and insert image objects.
 page = [doc insertPageWithType:1 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 NSString *image_file = @"sdk.png";
 AddImageObjects(page, image_file);

 output_file = @"graphics_objects_remove_text_objects.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a polyline annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add polyline annotation
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:500 bottom1:650 right1:600 top1:750];
 FSPolyLine* polyline = [[FSPolyLine alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotPolyLine rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [polyline setFlags:4];
 FSPointFArray* vertex_array = [FSPointFArray new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:515 y:705];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:535 y:740];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:565 y:740];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:585 y:705];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:565 y:665];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:535 y:665];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [polyline setVertexes:vertex_array];
 [polyline setSubject:@"PolyLine"];
 [polyline setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [polyline setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [polyline setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [polyline setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [polyline resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a polyline annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using Microsoft RMS security method.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

#include "openssl/bio.h"
#include "openssl/evp.h"
#include "openssl/objects.h"
#include "openssl/pem.h"
#include "openssl/pkcs12.h"
#include "openssl/pkcs7.h"
#include "openssl/sha.h"
#include "openssl/x509.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface RMSSecrutiyCallback : NSObject <FSRMSSecurityCallback>

@property (nonatomic, strong) NSData *encryptKey;

- (id)initWithEncryptKey:(NSData *)key;

@end

@implementation RMSSecrutiyCallback

- (id)initWithEncryptKey:(NSData *)key {
	if (self = [super init]) {
 self.encryptKey = key;
	}
	return self;
}

- (FSPDFDocEncryptType)GetSecurityType {
	return FSPDFDocEncryptRMS;
}

- (void *)createContext:(NSString *)filter sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter encrypt_info:(NSString *)encrypt_info {
	return NULL;
}

- (NSData *)decryptData:(void *)decryptor encrypted_data:(void *)encrypted_data encrypted_data_len:(unsigned int)encrypted_data_len {
	char* decryptedData = (char*)malloc(encrypted_data_len);
	for (uint32 i = 0; i < encrypted_data_len; i++)
 ((char*)decryptedData)[i] = ((char*)encrypted_data)[i] + 5;
	NSData *data = [NSData dataWithBytes:decryptedData length:encrypted_data_len];
	free(decryptedData);
	return data;
}

- (BOOL)encryptData:(void *)context obj_num:(int)obj_num gen_num:(int)gen_num src_data:(void *)src_data src_data_len:(unsigned int)src_data_len out_dst_buffer:(void *)out_dst_buffer out_dst_buffer_len:(unsigned int *)out_dst_buffer_len {
	for (uint32 i = 0; i < src_data_len; i++)
 ((char*)out_dst_buffer)[i] = ((char*)src_data)[i] - 5;
	*out_dst_buffer_len = src_data_len;
	return TRUE;
}

- (NSData *)finishDecryptor:(void *)decryptor {
	return [NSData new];
}

- (FSSecurityHandlerCipherType)getCipher:(void *)context {
	return FSSecurityHandlerCipherAES;
}

- (unsigned int)getDecryptedSize:(void *)context src_data_size:(unsigned int)src_data_size {
	return src_data_size;
}

- (NSData *)getEncryptKey:(void *)context {
	return self.encryptKey;
}

- (unsigned int)getEncryptedSize:(void *)context obj_num:(int)obj_num gen_num:(int)gen_num src_data:(void *)src_data src_data_len:(unsigned int)src_data_len {
	return src_data_len;
}

- (unsigned int)getUserPermissions:(void *)context user_permission:(FSPDFDocUserPermissions)user_permission {
	return 0xffffffc;
}

- (BOOL)isOwner:(void *)context {
	return TRUE;
}

- (BOOL)releaseContext:(void *)context {
	return TRUE;
}

- (void *)startDecryptor:(void *)context obj_num:(int)obj_num gen_num:(int)gen_num {
	return NULL;
}
-(BOOL)useStandardCryptoMethod:(void*)context {
 return FALSE;
}
@end

bool RMSSecurity(NSString *input_file) {
	@try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 // Do encryption.
 RMSSecrutiyCallback *callback = [[RMSSecrutiyCallback alloc] initWithEncryptKey:[@"Simple-RMS-encrpty-key" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]];
 FSRMSSecurityHandler *handler = [[FSRMSSecurityHandler alloc] init];
 NSArray<NSData *> *server_eul_list = @[
 [@"WM-1" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding],
 [@"This document has been encrypted by RMS encryption." dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding],
 [@"WM-2" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding],
 [@"Just for simple demo rms security." dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]
 ];
 FSRMSEncryptData *encrypt_data = [[FSRMSEncryptData alloc] initWithIs_encrypt_metadata:YES publish_license:@"PubishLicense_0123" server_eul_list:server_eul_list irm_version:1];
 [handler initialize:encrypt_data callback:callback];
 [doc setSecurityHandler:handler];
 NSString *output_file = @"rms_encrypt.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 // Do decryption.
 [FSLibrary registerSecurityCallback:@"MicrosoftIRMServices" callback:callback];
 FSPDFDoc *encrypted_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:output_file];
 code = [encrypted_doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 output_file = @"rms_decrypt.pdf";
 [encrypted_doc removeSecurity];
 [encrypted_doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 [FSLibrary unregisterSecurityCallback:@"Simple-RMS-encrpty-key"];
	}
	@catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return false;
	}
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 if (!RMSSecurity(input_file)) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a common stamp annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface MyIconProvider : NSObject<FSIconProviderCallback>
{
 @private
 BOOL use_dynamic_stamp_;
 NSString* icon_file_folder_;
}
-(id)init;
-(id)initWithPath:(NSString*)icon_file_folder;
-(void)setUseDynamicStamp:(BOOL)use_dynamic_stamp;
@end

@implementation MyIconProvider
-(id)init {
 use_dynamic_stamp_ = NO;
 icon_file_folder_ = @"";
 return self;
}

-(id)initWithPath:(NSString*)icon_file_folder{
 icon_file_folder_ = icon_file_folder;
 use_dynamic_stamp_ = NO;
 return self;
}

-(NSString*)getProviderID {
 if (use_dynamic_stamp_)
 return @"Simple Demo Dynamic MyIconProvider";
 else
 return @"Simple Demo MyIconProvider";
}

-(NSString*)getProviderVersion {
 return @"1.0.0";
}

-(BOOL)hasIcon:(FSAnnotType)annot_type icon_name:(NSString *)icon_name {
 NSString* icon_file_path = @"";
 if (use_dynamic_stamp_)
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_folder_ stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"DynamicStamps"];
 else
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_folder_ stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"StaticStamps"];
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:icon_name];
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_path stringByAppendingString:@".pdf"];
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:icon_file_path];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [doc load:nil];
 if (error_code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Fail to load icon file:%@, with error value: %ld", icon_file_path, error_code);
 return NO;
 }
 return ![doc isEmpty];
}

-(BOOL)canChangeColor:(FSAnnotType)annot_type icon_name:(NSString *)icon_name {
 return NO;
}

-(FSPDFPage*)getIcon:(FSAnnotType)annot_type icon_name:(NSString *)iconName color:(unsigned int)color {
 NSString* icon_file_path = @"";
 if (use_dynamic_stamp_)
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_folder_ stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"DynamicStamps"];
 else
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_folder_ stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"StaticStamps"];
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:iconName];
 icon_file_path = [icon_file_path stringByAppendingString:@".pdf"];

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:icon_file_path];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [doc load:nil];
 if (error_code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Fail to load icon file:%@, with error value: %ld", icon_file_path, error_code);
 return nil;
 }
 return [doc getPage:0];
}

-(FSShadingColor*)getShadingColor:(FSAnnotType)annot_type icon_name:(NSString *)icon_name referenced_color:(unsigned int)referenced_color shading_index:(int)shading_index {
 return nil;
}

-(NSNumber*)getDisplayWidth:(FSAnnotType)annot_type icon_name:(NSString *)icon_name {
 return [NSNumber numberWithFloat:0.0f];
}

-(NSNumber*)getDisplayHeight:(FSAnnotType)annot_type icon_name:(NSString *)icon_name {
 return [NSNumber numberWithFloat:0.0f];
}

-(void)setUseDynamicStamp:(BOOL)use_dynamic_stamp {
 use_dynamic_stamp_ = use_dynamic_stamp;
}

@end

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Set icon provider for annotation to Foxit PDF SDK.
 NSString* icon_folder = [stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"Stamps"];
 MyIconProvider* icon_provider = [[MyIconProvider alloc] initWithPath:icon_folder];
 [icon_provider setUseDynamicStamp:NO];
 [FSLibrary setAnnotIconProviderCallback:icon_provider];

 // Add common stamp annotation.
 [FSLibrary setActionCallback:nil];

 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:110 bottom1:150 right1:200 top1:250];
 FSStamp* static_stamp = [[FSStamp alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotStamp rect:annot_rect]];
 [static_stamp setIconName:@"Approved"];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [static_stamp setFlags:4];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [static_stamp resetAppearanceStream];

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

 return -1;

 @try {
 NSString *outputFile= @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 NSString *inputFile = @"AboutFoxit.txt";

 FSTXT2PDFSettingData* setting_data = [[FSTXT2PDFSettingData alloc] init];

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDk to add a arrow line annotation.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 // Add arrow line annotation
 // No special intent, as a common line.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:0 bottom1:650 right1:100 top1:750];
 FSLine* line = [[FSLine alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotLine rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [line setFlags:4];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:20 y:650];
 [line setStartPoint:point];
 [point set:100 y:740];
 [line setEndPoint:point];
 // Intent, as line arrow.
 [line setContent:@"A line arrow annotation"];
 [line setIntent:@"LineArrow"];
 [line setSubject:@"Arrow"];
 [line setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [line setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [line setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [line setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [line resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a line annotations.");
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get attributes of viewer preference and values of metadata in a PDF file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

FSDateTime *GetLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm *rime = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int) timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int) timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime *datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(rime->tm_year + 1900) month:(rime->tm_mon + 1) day:(rime->tm_mday) hour:(rime->tm_hour) minute:(rime->tm_min) second:(rime->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

FSDocViewerPrefsViewerPref kUIItems[6] = {FSDocViewerPrefsHideToolbar, FSDocViewerPrefsHideMenubar, FSDocViewerPrefsHideWindowUI, FSDocViewerPrefsFitWindow, FSDocViewerPrefsCenterWindow, FSDocViewerPrefsDisplayDocTitle};

// Set viewer preference information.
void SetDocViewerPrefsInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
 doc.displayMode = FSPDFDocDisplayFullScreen;
 FSDocViewerPrefs *prefs = [[FSDocViewerPrefs alloc] initWithDocument:doc pdf_dict:NULL];
 // Set UI visibility status.
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kUIItems) / (sizeof(kUIItems[0])); i++) {
 [prefs setUIDisplayStatus:kUIItems[i] value:YES];
 }
 // Set display mode for non full-screen mode.
 prefs.nonFullScreenPageMode = FSPDFDocDisplayUseOutlines;
 // Set reading direction.
 prefs.readingDirection = false;
 // Set the type of area item.
 prefs.viewArea = FSPDFPageCropBox;
 prefs.viewClip = FSPDFPageCropBox;
 prefs.printArea = FSPDFPageCropBox;
 prefs.printClip = FSPDFPageCropBox;
 // Set page scaling option.
 prefs.printScale = FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScaleNone;
 // Set the number of copies to be printed.
 prefs.printCopies = 4;
 FSRange *print_range = [[FSRange alloc] initWithStart_index:0 end_index:[doc getPageCount] / 2 filter:FSRangeAll];
 prefs.printRange = print_range;
}

NSString *kMetadataItems[8] = {@"Title", @"Author", @"Subject", @"Keywords", @"Creator", @"Producer", @"CreationDate", @"ModDate"};

// Set metadata information.
void SetMetaDataInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
	NSString *kMetadataValues[] = {@"Title set by simple demo", @"Simple demo", @"Subject set by simple demo", @"Keywords set by simple demo", @"Foxit PDF SDK", @"Foxit"};
 FSMetadata *metadata = [[FSMetadata alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kMetadataValues) / sizeof(kMetadataValues[0]); i++) {
 NSArray *MetadataValues = [[NSArray alloc] initWithObjects:kMetadataValues[i], nil];
 [metadata setValues:kMetadataItems[i] value_array:MetadataValues];
 }
 metadata.creationDateTime = GetLocalDateTime();
 metadata.modifiedDateTime = GetLocalDateTime();
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Set information.
 SetDocViewerPrefsInfo(doc);
 SetMetaDataInfo(doc);

 NSString *output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@", output_directory, @"AboutFoxit_docinfo.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to replace text in all pages in PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface ReplaceCallback : NSObject<FSReplaceCallback>

@end

@implementation ReplaceCallback {
	int count;
}

- (id)init {
	if (self = [super init]) {
 count = 0;
	}
	return self;
}

- (BOOL)needToReplace:(NSString *)search_text replace_text:(NSString *)replace_text current_page_index:(int)current_page_index text_rect_array:(FSRectFArray*)text_rect_array {
	count++;
	if (count <= 10) return YES;
	else return NO;
}

@end
int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"SearchReplaceText.pdf";
 NSString *output_file = @"SearchReplaceTextResult.pdf";

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Search for all pages of doc.
 FSTextSearchReplace *searchreplace = [[FSTextSearchReplace alloc] initWithDoc:doc];
 FSFindOption* find_option = [[FSFindOption alloc] initWithIs_whole_word:true is_case_sensitive:true];

 ReplaceCallback* replace_call_back = [[ReplaceCallback alloc] init];
 [searchreplace setReplaceCallback:replace_call_back];

 NSString *pattern = @"PDF";
 [searchreplace setPattern:pattern page_index:0 find_option:find_option];
 while ([searchreplace replaceNext:@"PDC"]) {}

 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:0];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to mark PDF content and get marked content from graphics objects.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void CreateMarkedContent(FSPDFPage *page) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 long position = [page getLastGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSTextObject *text_object = [FSTextObject create];

 text_object.fillColor = 0xFF83AF98;

 // Prepare text state
 FSTextState *state = [[FSTextState alloc] init];
 state.font_size = 72.f;
 FSFont *font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDTimesB];
 state.font = font;
 state.textmode = FSTextStateModeFill;

 [text_object setTextState:page text_state:state is_italic:NO weight:750];

 text_object.text = @"Marked-Content";
 [page insertGraphicsObject:position graphics_object:text_object];

 FSRectF *rect = [text_object getRect];
 float offset_x = ([page getWidth] - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = ([page getHeight] * 0.618f - (rect.top - rect.bottom)) / 2;
 [text_object transform:[[FSMatrix2D alloc] initWithA1:1 b1:0 c1:0 d1:1 e1:offset_x f1:offset_y] need_transform_clippath:NO];

 FSMarkedContent *content = [text_object getMarkedContent];
 FSPDFDictionary *span_dict = [FSPDFDictionary create];
 [span_dict setAtInteger:@"Direct" value:55];
 [content addItem:@"Span" property_dict:span_dict];

 // Generate content
 [page generateContent];
 }
}

bool GetMarkedContentObject(NSString *pdf_file) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:pdf_file];
 FSErrorCode ret = [doc load:@""];
 if (ret != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSTextObject *text_obj = [[page getGraphicsObject:position] getTextObject];
 FSMarkedContent *content = [text_obj getMarkedContent];
 int item_count = [content getItemCount];

 // Get marked content property
 for (int i = 0; i < item_count; i++) {
 NSString *tag_name = [content getItemTagName:i];
 int mcid = [content getItemMCID:i];
 }
 return true;
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeA4];

 // Create marked content
 CreateMarkedContent(page);

 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 // Get makred content object
 if (!GetMarkedContentObject(output_file)) {
 return 1;
 }

 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to combine form data and export these data to a CSV file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString * pdf_inputfile =@"Annot_all.pdf";
 FSCombineDocumentInfo *file_info1 =[[FSCombineDocumentInfo alloc] initWithFile_path:pdf_inputfile password:@""];
 [file_info1 setBookmarkTitle:@"Annot_all.pdf" ];
 [file_info1 setPDFFileName:@"Annot_all.pdf" ];

 NSString *pdf_inputfile2 = @"PDF2Img.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:pdf_inputfile2];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSCombineDocumentInfo *file_info2 =[[FSCombineDocumentInfo alloc] initWithDoc:doc];
 [file_info2 setBookmarkTitle:@"PDF2Img.pdf" ];
 [file_info2 setPDFFileName:@"PDF2Img.pdf" ];

 NSString * pdf_inputfile3 =[input_path stringByAppendingString:@"SamplePDF.pdf"];
 FSCombineDocumentInfo *file_info3 =[[FSCombineDocumentInfo alloc] initWithFile_path:pdf_inputfile3 password:@""];
 [file_info3 setBookmarkTitle:@"SamplePDF.pdf" ];
 [file_info3 setPDFFileName:@"SamplePDF.pdf" ];

 FSCombineDocumentInfoArray *combine_document_array = [[FSCombineDocumentInfoArray alloc] init];
 [combine_document_array add:file_info1];
 [combine_document_array add:file_info2];
 [combine_document_array add:file_info3];

 NSString* pdf_outputfile = @"pdfcombination.pdf";
 [FSCombination startCombineDocuments:pdf_outputfile document_array:combine_document_array options:0xFFFFFFFC pause:nil];

 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of delete text type.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* rime = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(rime->tm_year + 1900) month:(rime->tm_mon + 1) day:(rime->tm_mday) hour:(rime->tm_hour) minute:(rime->tm_min) second:(rime->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

void CreateDeleteText(FSPDFPage* page, FSRectFArray* rects, int color, NSString *csContents, NSString *csType, NSString *csObjType) {
 if (rects == NULL) return;
 int rectSize = [rects getSize];
 if (rectSize == 0) return;
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 FSStrikeOut* strikeout = [[FSStrikeOut alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotStrikeOut rect:annot_rect]];
 [strikeout setContent:csContents];

 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];

 for (int i=0; i<rectSize; i++) {
 FSRectF* item = [rects getAt:i];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:item.left y:item.top];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:item.right y:item.top];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:item.left y:item.bottom];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:item.right y:item.bottom];
 quad_points.fourth = point;

 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 }
 [strikeout setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];
 [strikeout setBorderColor:color];
 [strikeout setSubject:csObjType];
 [strikeout setTitle:csType];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [strikeout setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [strikeout setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [strikeout setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 [strikeout resetAppearanceStream];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *base_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_base_file];
 errorCode = [base_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSPDFDoc *compared_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_compared_file];
 errorCode = [compared_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSComparison* comparison = [[FSComparison alloc] initWithBase_doc:base_doc compared_doc:compared_doc];
 FSCompareResults* result = [comparison doCompare:0 compared_page_index:0 compare_flags:FSComparisonCompareTypeText];
 int oldInfoSize = [result.base_doc_results getSize];
 FSPDFPage* page = [compared_doc getPage:0];
 for (int i=0; i<oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 FSCompareResultInfo* item = [result.compared_doc_results getAt:i];
 FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultTypeDeleteText)
 {
 NSString* res_string = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"\"%@\"", item.diff_contents];
 CreateDeleteText(page1, item.rect_array, 0xff0000, res_string, @"Compare : Delete", @"Text");
 }
 }
 FSPDFDoc* new_doc = [comparison generateComparedDoc:FSComparisonCompareTypeAll];
 [new_doc saveAs:@"generate_result.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add, delete and modify the header-footer of PDF file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_name = @"HeaderFooter.pdf";
 NSString* input_pdf_path = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:input_pdf_name];

 // Load PDF document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld", input_pdf_path, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 FSHeaderFooter* headerfooter = [doc getEditableHeaderFooter];
 // Update header-footer
 FSHeaderFooterContentGenerator* contentgenerator = [[FSHeaderFooterContentGenerator alloc] init];
 [contentgenerator addDate:FSHeaderFooterContentGeneratorDateFormatMSlashDSlashYYYY];
 [contentgenerator addString:@" foxit"];
 FSHeaderFooterContent* content = headerfooter.content;
 content.header_right_content = [contentgenerator generateContent];
 [doc updateHeaderFooter:headerfooter];
 NSString* output_file = @"HeaderFooter_UpdateHeaderFooter.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 // Add header-footer
 headerfooter.text_color = 0x00FFFF;
 headerfooter.page_range = [[FSPageNumberRange alloc] initWithStart_number:1 end_number:[doc getPageCount] filter:FSRangeOdd];
 headerfooter.has_fixedsize_for_print = false;
 headerfooter.has_text_shrinked = false;
 headerfooter.start_page_number = 2;
 headerfooter.page_margin = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:36 bottom1:70 right1:36 top1:70];
 headerfooter.text_size = 8;
 [doc addHeaderFooter:headerfooter];
 output_file = @"HeaderFooter_AddHeaderFooter.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 //Remove all header-footers
 [doc removeAllHeaderFooters];
 output_file = @"HeaderFooter_RemoveAll.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return is_run_success? 0 : 1;
	}

}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert pdf to image.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void Save2Image(FSBitmap* bitmap, int page_index, NSString* extension_str, bool from_memory) {
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 FSImage* image = [FSImage new];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 NSString* file_name = [NSString new];
 if (from_memory)
 file_name = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"AboutFoxit_from_memory_%d",page_index];
 else
 file_name = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"AboutFoxit_%d",page_index];
 NSString* save_image_path = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@%@", output_directory, file_name, extension_str];
 [image saveAs:save_image_path];
 NSLog(@"Save page %d into a picture of %@ format.", page_index, extension_str);
}

void Save2Image(FSImage* image, NSString* extension_str, bool from_memory) {
 NSString* file_name = @"AboutFoxit";
 if (from_memory)
 file_name = [file_name stringByAppendingString:@"_from_memory"];
 NSString* save_image_path = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@%@", output_directory, file_name, extension_str];
 [image saveAs:save_image_path];
 NSLog(@"Save image file to %@ format.", extension_str);
}

void pdf2Image(FSPDFDoc* doc, bool from_memory) {
 NSArray* support_image_extends = [NSArray arrayWithObjects:@".bmp", @".jpg", @".jpeg", @".png", @".jpx", @".jp2", nil];
 NSArray* support_multi_image = [NSArray arrayWithObjects:@".tif", @".tiff", nil];

 FSImage* image = [FSImage new];
 // Get page count
 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for(int i=0;i<page_count;i++) {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 int width = (int)[page getWidth];
 int height = (int)[page getHeight];
 FSMatrix2D* matrix = [page getDisplayMatrix:0 top:0 width:width height:height rotate:page.rotation];

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 FSBitmap* bitmap = [[FSBitmap alloc] initWithWidth:width height:height format:FSBitmapDIBArgb buffer:nil pitch:0];
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:nil];

 // Render page
 FSRenderer* render = [[FSRenderer alloc] initWithBitmap:bitmap is_rgb_order:NO];
 [render startRender:page matrix:matrix pause:nil];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 NSUInteger suppot_image_ext_count = [support_image_extends count];
 for(NSUInteger j=0;j<suppot_image_ext_count;j++) {
 NSString* extend = [support_image_extends objectAtIndex:j];
 Save2Image(bitmap,i,extend,from_memory);
 }

 }
 NSUInteger support_multi_image_count =[support_multi_image count];
 for(NSUInteger j=0;j<support_multi_image_count;j++) {
 NSString* extend = [support_multi_image objectAtIndex:j];
 Save2Image(image,extend,from_memory);
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 bool is_run_success = false;
 @try {
 NSString* pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld", pdf_path, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }
 pdf2Image(doc, false);

 }

 {
 NSLog(@"Load document from memory.");
 NSData* file_data = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:pdf_path];

 FSPDFDoc* doc_from_mem = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithBuffer:file_data];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc_from_mem load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld", pdf_path, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }
 pdf2Image(doc_from_mem, true);
 }
 is_run_success = true;
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert jp2 files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert jp2 to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jp2";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jp2.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert jp2 to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jp2";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jp2_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert jp2 to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jp2";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jp2_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to creat a pressure sensitive ink and convert it to annotation.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

namespace {
 float[] kPointsData = {
 1, 121.3043f, 326.6846f, 0.0966f, 2, 121.1304f, 326.8709f, 0.1376f, 2, 121.1304f, 326.9641f, 0.1484f,
 2, 121.1304f, 327.0572f, 0.2226f, 2, 121.1304f, 327.2435f, 0.3203f, 2, 121.1304f, 327.5230f, 0.3916f,
 2, 121.4782f, 330.7833f, 0.7041f, 2, 122.0000f, 331.4354f, 0.7275f, 2, 122.9565f, 331.9943f, 0.7363f,
 2, 546.0869f, 402.0447f, 0.5322f, 3, 546.0869f, 402.0447f, 0.0000f
 };
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPSI *psi = [[FSPSI alloc] initWithWidth:480 height:180 simulate:YES];
 [psi setDiameter:9];
 [psi setColor:0x434236];
 [psi setOpacity:0.8f];

 // Add points to pressure sensitive ink.
 for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(kPointsData) / sizeof(kPointsData[0]); i += 4) {
 float x = kPointsData[i + 1] - 100.f;
 float y = kPointsData[i + 2] - 300.f;
 FSPointF *pt = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 pt.x = x;
 pt.y = y;
 float pressure = kPointsData[i + 3];
 FSPathPointType type = FSPathPointType((int) kPointsData[i]);
 [psi addPoint:pt type:type pressure:pressure];
 }

 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:[psi getBitmap]];
 NSString *output_file = @"pressure_sensitive_ink.bmp";
 [image saveAs:output_file];

 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeA4];
 // Convert PSI to PSInk annotation.
 float width = 480.f;
 float height = 180.f;
 float pageWidth = [page getWidth];
 float pageHeight = [page getHeight];
 FSRectF *rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:(pageWidth / 2 - width / 2) bottom1:(pageHeight / 2 - height / 2) right1:(pageWidth / 2 + width / 2) top1:(pageHeight / 2 + height / 2)];

 FSAnnot *annot = [psi convertToPDFAnnot:page annot_rect:rect rotate:FSRotation0];
 annot = nil;

 output_file = @"pressure_sensitive_ink.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 cout << "PSI test." << endl;
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }

 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using custom security method

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface CustomSecurityEvent : NSObject <FSCustomSecurityCallback>

@end

@implementation CustomSecurityEvent

- (FSPDFDocEncryptType)GetSecurityType {
	return FSPDFDocEncryptCustom;
}

- (void *)createContext:(NSString *)filter sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter encrypt_info:(NSString *)encrypt_info {
	return NULL;
}

- (NSData *)decryptData:(void *)decryptor encrypted_data:(void *)encrypted_data encrypted_data_len:(unsigned int)encrypted_data_len {
	char* decrypted_data = (char*)malloc(encrypted_data_len);
	for (uint32 i = 0; i < encrypted_data_len; i++)
 ((char*)decrypted_data)[i] = ((char*)encrypted_data)[i] + 1;
	NSData *data = [NSData dataWithBytes:decrypted_data length:encrypted_data_len];
	free(decrypted_data);
	return data;
}

- (BOOL)encryptData:(void *)context obj_num:(int)obj_num gen_num:(int)gen_num src_data:(void *)src_data src_data_len:(unsigned int)src_data_len out_dst_buffer:(void *)out_dst_buffer out_dst_buffer_len:(unsigned int *)out_dst_buffer_len {
 for (uint32 i = 0; i < src_data_len; i++)
 ((char*)out_dst_buffer)[i] = ((char*)src_data)[i] - 1;
 *out_dst_buffer_len = src_data_len;
 return TRUE;
}

- (NSData *)finishDecryptor:(void *)decryptor {
	return [NSData new];
}

- (FSSecurityHandlerCipherType)getCipher:(void *)context {
	return FSSecurityHandlerCipherAES;
}

- (unsigned int)getDecryptedSize:(void *)context src_data_size:(unsigned int)src_data_size {
	return src_data_size;
}

- (NSData *)getEncryptKey:(void *)context {
	return [@"key" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
}

- (unsigned int)getEncryptedSize:(void *)context obj_num:(int)obj_num gen_num:(int)gen_num src_data:(void *)src_data src_data_len:(unsigned int)src_data_len {
	return src_data_len;
}

- (unsigned int)getUserPermissions:(void *)context user_permission:(FSPDFDocUserPermissions)user_permission {
	return 0xffffffc;
}

- (BOOL)isOwner:(void *)context {
	return TRUE;
}

- (BOOL)releaseContext:(void *)context {
	return TRUE;
}

- (void *)startDecryptor:(void *)context obj_num:(int)obj_num gen_num:(int)gen_num {
	return NULL;
}
-(BOOL)useStandardCryptoMethod:(void*)context {
 return FALSE;
}
@end

bool CustomSecurity(NSString *input_file) {
	@try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", input_file, (int)code);
 return false;
 }

 // Do encryption.
 CustomSecurityEvent *callback = [[CustomSecurityEvent alloc] init];
 FSCustomSecurityHandler *handler = [[FSCustomSecurityHandler alloc] init];
 NSString *encrypt_info = @"Foxit simple demo custom security";
 FSCustomEncryptData *encrypt_data = [[FSCustomEncryptData alloc] initWithIs_encrypt_metadata:YES filter:@"Custom" sub_filter:@"foxit-simple-demo"];
 [handler initialize:encrypt_data callback:callback encrypt_info:encrypt_info];
 [doc setSecurityHandler:handler];
 NSString *output_file = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"custom_encrypt.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 // Do decryption.
 [FSLibrary registerSecurityCallback:@"Custom" callback:callback];
 FSPDFDoc *encrypted_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:output_file];
 code = [encrypted_doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", output_file, (int)code);
 return false;
 }

 output_file = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"custom_decrypt.pdf"];
 [encrypted_doc removeSecurity];
 [encrypted_doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 [FSLibrary unregisterSecurityCallback:@"Custom"];
	}
	@catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return false;
	}
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 if (!CustomSecurity(input_file)) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDk to add a common line annotation.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 // Add a common line annotation
 annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:0 bottom1:650 right1:100 top1:760];
 line = [[FSLine alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotLine rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [line setFlags:4];
 // Set foxit RGB color
 [line setBorderColor:0x00FF00];
 [point set:10 y:650];
 [line setStartPoint:point];
 [point set:100 y:750];
 [line setEndPoint:point];
 [line setContent:@"A common line."];
 [line setLineStartStyle:FSMarkupEndingStyleSquare];
 [line setLineEndStyle:FSMarkupEndingStyleOpenArrow];
 // Show text in line
 [line enableCaption:YES];
 [point set:0 y:5];
 [line setCaptionOffset:point];

 [line setSubject:@"Line"];
 [line setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [line setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [line setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [line setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [line resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a line annotations.");
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to open a portfolio PDF file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void OutputFileNodeInfo( FSPortfolioFileNode* node, int tab_count) {
 NSString* key_name = [node getKeyName];
 FSFileSpec* file_spec = [node getFileSpec];
 NSString* file_name = [file_spec getFileName];
 NSString* description = [file_spec getDescription];
}

void OutputFolderNodeInfo(FSPortfolioFolderNode* node, int tab_count) {
 NSString* name = [node getName];
 NSString* description = [node getDescription];

 FSPortfolioNodeArray* sub_nodes = [node getSortedSubNodes];
 OutputSubNodesInfo(sub_nodes, tab_count + 1);
}

void OutputNodeInfo(FSPortfolioNode* node, int tab_count) {
 switch ([node getNodeType]) {
 case FSPortfolioNodeTypeFolder:
 OutputFolderNodeInfo([[FSPortfolioFolderNode alloc] initWithOther:node], tab_count);
 break;
 case FSPortfolioNodeTypeFile:
 OutputFileNodeInfo([[FSPortfolioFileNode alloc] initWithOther:node], tab_count);
 break;
 default:
 break;
 }
}

void OutputSubNodesInfo(FSPortfolioNodeArray* sub_nodes, int tab_count) {
 for (unsigned long index = 0; index < [sub_nodes getSize]; index++) {
 if (tab_count > 0)
 OutputTab(tab_count);
 OutputNodeInfo([sub_nodes getAt:index], tab_count);
 }
}

void OutputSchemaFields(FSSchemaFieldArray* field_array) {
 if ([field_array getSize] <= 0) return;
 for (unsigned long i = 0; i < [field_array getSize]; i++) {
 FSSchemaField* field = [field_array getAt:i];
 if (YES == [field isEmpty]) continue;
 NSString* key_name = [field getKeyName];
 NSString* subtype_name = [field getSubtypeName];
 NSString* display_name = [field getDisplayName];
 BOOL is_visible = [field isVisible];
 }
}

void OutputPortfolioProperties(FSPortfolio* portfolio) {
 NSString* initial_filespec_keyname = [portfolio getInitialFileSpecKeyName];
 FSPortfolioInitialViewMode view_mode = [portfolio getInitialViewMode];
 BOOL is_ascending = [portfolio isSortedInAscending];
 NSString* sorting_field_name = [portfolio getSortingFieldKeyName];
 FSSchemaFieldArray* field_array = [portfolio getSchemaFields];
 OutputSchemaFields(field_array);
}

void OutputPortfolioPDFInfo(NSString* input_file) {
 FSPDFDoc* pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [pdf_doc load:nil];
 if (error_code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }

 if (NO == [pdf_doc isPortfolio]) {
 return;
 }

 FSPortfolio* exist_portfolio = [FSPortfolio createPortfolioWithPDFDoc:pdf_doc];
 if (YES == [exist_portfolio isEmpty]) {
 return;
 }
 // Output portfolio properties.
 OutputPortfolioProperties(exist_portfolio);

 // Output all nodes.
 FSPortfolioNode* root_node = [exist_portfolio getRootNode];
 FSPortfolioFolderNode* root_folder = [[FSPortfolioFolderNode alloc] initWithOther:root_node];
 FSPortfolioNodeArray* sub_nodes = [root_folder getSortedSubNodes];
 OutputSubNodesInfo(sub_nodes, 0);

}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_file = @"new_portfolio.pdf";
 // Open portfolio PDF file.
 OutputPortfolioPDFInfo(input_file);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to extract text from PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 bool is_run_success = false;
 @try {
 NSString *pdfPath = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:pdfPath];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 NSString *text = @"";
 int pageCount = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i ++) {
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:i];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 FSTextPage *textPage = [[FSTextPage alloc] initWithPage:page flags:FSTextPageParseTextNormal];
 int charCount = [textPage getCharCount];
 if (charCount > 0) {
 NSString *currentText = [textPage getChars:0 count:-1];
 NSLog(@"%@", currentText);
 }
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do LTV verification (using default callback) in PDF document

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

@interface MyTrustedCertStoreCallback : NSObject<FSTrustedCertStoreCallback>

@end

@implementation MyTrustedCertStoreCallback {
}

- (id)init {
 return self;
}

-(BOOL)isCertTrusted:(NSData*)cert {
	return YES;
}

-(BOOL)isCertTrustedRoot:(NSData*)cert {
	return YES;
}
@end

void UseLTVVerifier(FSPDFDoc* pdf_doc, bool is_to_add_dss) {
 // Here use default RevocationCallback, so no need to call FSLTVVerifier::setRevocationCallback
 FSLTVVerifier* ltv_verifier = [[FSLTVVerifier alloc] initWithDocument:pdf_doc is_verify_signature:YES use_expired_tst:YES ignore_doc_info:NO time_type:FSLTVVerifierSignatureCreationTime];

 MyTrustedCertStoreCallback* my_callback = [[MyTrustedCertStoreCallback alloc] init];
 [ltv_verifier setTrustedCertStoreCallback:my_callback];

 [ltv_verifier setVerifyMode:FSLTVVerifierVerifyModeAcrobat];
 // TODO: ADJUST CODE FROM HERE.
 FSSignatureVerifyResultArray* sig_verify_result_array = [ltv_verifier verify];
 unsigned long array_size = [sig_verify_result_array getSize];
 for (unsigned long i = 0; i < array_size; i++) {
 FSSignatureVerifyResult* sig_verify_result = [sig_verify_result_array getAt:i];
 NSString* signature_name = [sig_verify_result getSignatureName];
 unsigned int sig_state = [sig_verify_result getSignatureState];
 FSSignatureVerifyResultLTVState ltv_state = [sig_verify_result getLTVState];
 NSString* ltv_state_str;
 switch (ltv_state) {
 case FSSignatureVerifyResultLTVStateInactive:
 ltv_state_str = @"inactive";
 break;
 case FSSignatureVerifyResultLTVStateEnable:
 ltv_state_str = @"enabled";
 break;
 case FSSignatureVerifyResultLTVStateNotEnable:
 ltv_state_str = @"not enabled";
 break;
 }
 }

 if (is_to_add_dss) {
 for (size_t i = 0; i < array_size; i++) {
 FSSignatureVerifyResult* sig_verify_result = [sig_verify_result_array getAt:i];
 if (([sig_verify_result getSignatureState] & FSSignatureStateVerifyValid) == FSSignatureStateVerifyValid)
 [ltv_verifier addDSS:sig_verify_result];
 }
 }
}

void DoLTV(NSString* signed_pdf_path, NSString* saved_ltv_pdf_path) {
 // Use default SignatureCallback for signing a time stamp signature with filter "Adobe.PPKLite" and subfilter "ETSI.RFC3161",
 NSString* free_server_name = @"FreeTSAServer";
 NSString* free_server_url = @"http://ca.signfiles.com/TSAServer.aspx";
 [FSTimeStampServerMgr initialize];
 FSTimeStampServer* timestamp_server = [FSTimeStampServerMgr addServer:free_server_name server_url:free_server_url user_name:@"" password:@""];
 [FSTimeStampServerMgr setDefaultServer:timestamp_server];

 FSPDFDoc *pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:signed_pdf_path];
 [pdf_doc startLoad:nil is_cache_stream:NO pause:nil];

 // Add DTS
 FSPDFPage *pdf_page = [pdf_doc getPage:0];
 // The new time stamp signature will have default filter name "Adobe.PPKLite" and default subfilter name "ETSI.RFC3161".
 FSRectF* empty_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 FSSignature* timestamp_signature = [pdf_page addSignatureWithSignatureType:empty_rect field_name:@"" signature_type:FSSignatureSignatureTypeTimeStamp to_check_permission:YES];
 [timestamp_signature startSign:@"" cert_password:@"" digest_algorithm:FSSignatureDigestSHA1 save_path:saved_ltv_pdf_path client_data:nil pause:nil];

 // Check saved file.
 FSPDFDoc *check_pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:saved_ltv_pdf_path];
 [check_pdf_doc startLoad:nil is_cache_stream:NO pause:nil];
 // Just LTV veify.
 printf("== After Add DSS ==\r\n");
 UseLTVVerifier(check_pdf_doc, false);

 [FSTimeStampServerMgr destroy];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file_path = @"AboutFoxit_PKCS7_Signature.pdf";
 @try {
 // Note PDF need have Add a PKCS7 signature and sign it.
 // Do LTV
 NSString* saved_ltv_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit_PKCS7_Signature_ltv.pdf";
 DoLTV(signed_pdf_path, saved_ltv_pdf_path);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }

 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert a PDF file to PDFA-1.4 version.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface MyComplianceProgressCallback : NSObject<FSComplianceProgressCallback>
{
}
-(id)init;
@end

@implementation MyComplianceProgressCallback

-(id)init {
	return self;
}

-(void)updateCurrentStateData: (int)current_rate current_state_string: (NSString*)current_state_string {
	NSLog(@"Current rate: %d", current_rate);
}

@end

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 NSString* compliance_resource_folder_path = @"";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for FSComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 NSString* compliance_engine_unlockcode = @"";

 if ([compliance_resource_folder_path length] < 1) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 errorCode = [FSComplianceEngine initialize:compliance_resource_folder_path compliance_engine_unlockcode:compliance_engine_unlockcode];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"1_pdfacompliance_convert_to_pdf14.pdf";
 {
 // Convert original PDF file to PDF-1.4 version.
 MyComplianceProgressCallback* convert_progress_callback = [[MyComplianceProgressCallback alloc] init];
 FSResultInformation* convert_result_info = [pdfa_compliance convertPDFFile:input_file saved_pdf_path:save_pdf_path convert_to_version:14 progress_callback:convert_progress_callback];
 }

 // Release compliance engine.
 [FSComplianceEngine destroy];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into catalog dictionary.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 NSString *input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FSFileSpec *filespec_txt = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_txt.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_txt.fileName = @"1.txt";
 FSDateTime *dateTime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:15 hour:17 minute:20 second:20 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 filespec_txt.description = @"text";
 [filespec_txt embed:@"1.txt"];
 filespec_txt.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 1.txt with catalog dictionary.
 FSPDFObject *catalog_dict = [doc getCatalog];
 [associated_files associateFile:catalog_dict file_spec:filespec_txt];
 FSFileSpec *filespec_catalog = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:catalog_dict index:0];
 [filespec_catalog exportToFile:@"catalog.txt"];

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert from html to pdf by path.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }
 NSString *url_or_html = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"AboutFoxit.html"];
 // "engine_path" is the path of the engine file "fxhtml2pdf" which is used to convert html to pdf. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 NSString *engine_path = @"";
 // "cookies_path" is the path of the cookies file exported from the web pages that you want to convert. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 NSString *cookies_path = @"";
 NSString *output_file_path = [output_directory stringByAppendingString:@"html2pdf_result.pdf"];
 int time_out = 15;

 @try {

 FSHTML2PDFSettingData *pdf_setting_data=[FSHTML2PDFSettingData new];
 pdf_setting_data.is_convert_link = true;
 pdf_setting_data.is_generate_tag = true;
 pdf_setting_data.to_generate_bookmarks = true;
 pdf_setting_data.rotate_degrees = 0;
 pdf_setting_data.page_height = 640;
 pdf_setting_data.page_width = 900;
 pdf_setting_data.page_mode = FSHTML2PDFSettingDataPageModeSinglePage;
 pdf_setting_data.scaling_mode = FSHTML2PDFSettingDataScalingModeScale;
 pdf_setting_data.to_print_background = true;
 pdf_setting_data.to_optimize_tag_tree = false;
 pdf_setting_data.media_style = FSHTML2PDFSettingDataMediaStyleScreen;

 [FSConvert fromHTML:url_or_html engine_path:engine_path cookies_path:cookies_path setting_data:pdf_setting_data saved_pdf_path:output_file_path timeout:time_out];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a polygon annotation with dashed border.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add polygon annotation, with dashed border.
 FSFloatArray* dash_array = [FSFloatArray new];
 [dash_array setSize:2 nGrowBy:-1];
 [dash_array setAt:0 newElement:2];
 [dash_array setAt:1 newElement:2];
 FSBorderInfo* borderinfo = [[FSBorderInfo alloc] initWithWidth:2.0 style:FSBorderInfoDashed intensity:2.0 dash_phase:3.0 dashes:dash_array];

 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:400 bottom1:650 right1:500 top1:750];
 FSPolygon* polygon = [[FSPolygon alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotPolygon rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [polygon setFlags:4];
 [polygon setFillColor:0x0000FF];
 [polygon setBorderInfo:borderinfo];

 FSPointFArray* vertex_array = [FSPointFArray new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:435 y:665];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:465 y:665];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:485 y:705];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:465 y:740];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:435 y:740];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:415 y:705];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [polygon setVertexes:vertex_array];

 [polygon setSubject:@"Polygon"];
 [polygon setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [polygon setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [polygon setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [polygon setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [polygon resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a polygon cloud annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}
