How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get/set page label information in a PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void showPageLabelsInfo(FSPDFDoc* doc) {
 NSString* record_content = [NSString new];
 FSPageLabels* page_labels = [[FSPageLabels alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 int count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 FSPageLabelsStyle style = [page_labels getPageLabelStyle:i]
 NSString *title = [page_labels getPageLabelTitle:i];
 NSString *prefix = [page_labels getPageLabelPrefix:i]
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"page_labels.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Get page labels
 showPageLabelsInfo(doc);

 // Add new page labels
 FSPageLabels* page_labels = [[FSPageLabels alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // remove all page labels
 [page_labels removeAll];
 NSString* save_pdf_path_removeall = @"removeall_page_labels.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path_removeall save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 int count = [doc getPageCount];
 if (count > 0) {
 [page_labels setPageLabel:0 label_style:FSPageLabelsUpperRomanNums first_label_number:1 prefix_string:@"Cover-"];
 }
 if (count > 1) {
 [page_labels setPageLabel:1 label_style:FSPageLabelsLowerRomanNums first_label_number:1 prefix_string:@"Catolog-"];
 }
 if (count > 2) {
 [page_labels setPageLabel:2 label_style:FSPageLabelsDecimalNums first_label_number:1 prefix_string:@"Contents-"];
 }
 if (count > 5) {
 [page_labels setPageLabel:count-1 label_style:FSPageLabelsUpperLetters first_label_number:1 prefix_string:@"Appendix-"];
 }

 // Get page labels
 showPageLabelsInfo(doc);
 NSString* save_pdf_path_new = @"new_page_labels.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path_new save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a callout freetext annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

 time_t t = time(NULL);

 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation, as call-out.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:300 bottom1:550 right1:400 top1:600];
 FSFreeText* freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [freetext setFlags:4];
 // Set default appearance
 unsigned int da_flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 FSFont* da_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelveticaB];
 FSDefaultAppearance* default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:da_flags font:da_font text_size:12.0 text_color:0x000000];
 // Set default appearance for form.
 [freetext setDefaultAppearance:default_ap];
 [freetext setIntent:@"FreeTextCallout"];
 FSPointFArray* callout_points = [FSPointFArray new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:250 y:540];
 [callout_points add:point];
 [point set:280 y:570];
 [callout_points add:point];
 [point set:300 y:570];
 [callout_points add:point];
 [freetext setCalloutLinePoints:callout_points];
 [freetext setCalloutLineEndingStyle:FSMarkupEndingStyleOpenArrow];

 [freetext setContent:@"A callout annotation."];
 [freetext setSubject:@"FreeTextCallout"];
 [freetext setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [freetext setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a callout freetext annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do optimize in PDF documents under a folder.

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface PauseUtil : NSObject<FSPauseCallback>
@property int pause_count_limit_;
@property int pause_count_;
-(id)init;
-(id)initWithParam:(int)pause_limit_;
-(BOOL)needPauseNow;
@end
@implementation PauseUtil
-(id)init {
 _pause_count_ = 0;
	_pause_count_limit_ = 30;
	return self;
}

-(id)initWithParam:(int)pause_limit_{
 self = [super init];
 if(self){
	_pause_count_limit_ = pause_limit_;
	}
 return self;
}

- (BOOL)needPauseNow {
	if (_pause_count_ < _pause_count_limit_)
	{
 _pause_count_++;
 return true;
	}
	else
	{
 _pause_count_ = 0;
 return false;
	}
}
@end
int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 //Image Compression Optimization
 @try {
 NSString *input_file = @"[Optimize]ImageCompression.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 PauseUtil* pause = [[PauseUtil alloc]initWithParam:30];
 FSOptimizerSettings* settings = [[FSOptimizerSettings alloc]init];
 [settings setOptimizerOptions:FSOptimizerSettingsOptimizerCompressImages];
 FSProgressive *progressive = [FSOptimizer optimize:doc settings:settings pause:pause];
 while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 int rate = [progressive getRateOfProgress];

 }
 NSString *output_file = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"ImageCompression_Optimized.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }

 // Clean up Optimization
 @try {
 NSString *input_file = @"[Optimize]Cleanup.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 PauseUtil* pause = [[PauseUtil alloc]initWithParam:30];
 FSOptimizerSettings* settings = [[FSOptimizerSettings alloc]init];
 [settings setOptimizerOptions:FSOptimizerSettingsOptimizerCleanUp];
 int cleanup_options = FSOptimizerSettingsCleanUpUseFlateForNonEncodedStream | FSOptimizerSettingsCleanUpUseFlateInsteadOfLZW
 | FSOptimizerSettingsCleanUpRemoveInvalidBookmarks | FSOptimizerSettingsCleanUpRemoveInvalidLinks;
 [settings setCleanUpOptions:cleanup_options];
 FSProgressive *progressive = [FSOptimizer optimize:doc settings:settings pause:pause];
 while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 int rate = [progressive getRateOfProgress];
 }
 NSString *output_file = @"Cleanup_Optimized.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }

 // Discard objects Optimization
 @try {
 NSString *input_file = @"[Optimize]DiscardObjects.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 PauseUtil* pause = [[PauseUtil alloc]initWithParam:30];
 FSOptimizerSettings* settings = [[FSOptimizerSettings alloc]init];
 [settings setOptimizerOptions:FSOptimizerSettingsOptimizerDiscardObjects];
 int discardobjects_options = FSOptimizerSettingsDiscardObjectsFormActions | FSOptimizerSettingsDiscardObjectsFlattenFormFields
 | FSOptimizerSettingsDiscardObjectsJavaScriptActions | FSOptimizerSettingsDiscardObjectsEmbeddedPageThumbnails
 | FSOptimizerSettingsDiscardObjectsEmbeddedPrintSettings | FSOptimizerSettingsDiscardObjectsBookmarks;
 [settings setDiscardObjectsOptions:discardobjects_options];
 FSProgressive *progressive = [FSOptimizer optimize:doc settings:settings pause:pause];
 while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 int rate = [progressive getRateOfProgress];
 }
 NSString *output_file = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"DiscardObjects_Optimized.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to to call layout recognition related classes for PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void OutputLRStructureElement(FSLRStructureElement* element, int depth) {
 if ([element isEmpty])
 return;

 FSLRStructureElement* parentElement = [element getParentElement];
 BOOL bIsEmpty = [parentElement isEmpty];

 FSLRElementElementType elemType = [element getElementType];
 NSString* elementTypeStr = [FSLRStructureElement stringifyElementType:elemType];
}

void OutputLRStructureElement(FSLRGraphicsObjectElement* element, int depth) {
 if ([element isEmpty])
 return;

 FSLRGraphicsObjectElement* parentPageObj = [element getParentGraphicsObjectElement];
 BOOL bIsEmpty = [parentPageObj isEmpty];
 FSGraphicsObject* pageObj = [element getGraphicsObject];
 FSGraphicsObjectType type = 0;
 if (pageObj != nil)
 type = [pageObj getType];
 FSRectF* rcBox = [element getBBox];
 FSPDFDictionary* pDict = [element getDict];
 int objIndex = [element getGraphicsObjectIndex];
 FSMatrix2D* matrix = [element getMatrix];
 NSString* text = (type == FSGraphicsObjectTypeText) ? [[pageObj getTextObject] getText] : @"";
}

void OutputLRStructureElement(FSLRContentElement* element, int depth) {
 if ([element isEmpty])
 return;

 FSLRGraphicsObjectElement* pageObj = [element getGraphicsObjectElement];
 BOOL bIsEmpty = [pageObj isEmpty];
 FSLRStructureElement* parentPageObj = [element getParentElement];
 bIsEmpty = [parentPageObj isEmpty];

 FSLRElementElementType elemType = [element getElementType];
 NSString* elementTypeStr = [FSLRElement stringifyElementType:elemType];

 FSRectF* rcBox = [element getBBox];
 int nStartPos = 0, nLength = 0;
 FSRange* range = [element getGraphicsObjectRange];
 if (![range isEmpty]) {
 nStartPos = [range getSegmentStart:0];
 nLength = [range getSegmentEnd:0] - nStartPos + 1;
 }
 FSMatrix2D* matrix = [element getMatrix];

 if (!bIsEmpty)
 OutputLRStructureElement(pageObj, doc, depth + 1);
}

void showLRElementInfo(FSLRStructureElement* element, int depth) {
 int nElemListSize = [element getChildCount];
 OutputLRStructureElement(element, depth);
 for (int i = 0; i < nElemListSize; i++) {
 FSLRElement* item = [element getChild:i];
 FSLRElementElementType item_type = [item getElementType];
 if ([item isStructureElement]) {
 FSLRStructureElement* srt_item = [[FSLRStructureElement alloc] initWithElement:item];
 showLRElementInfo(srt_item, depth + 1);
 } else if ([item isContentElement]) {
 FSLRContentElement* srt_item = [[FSLRContentElement alloc] initWithElement:item];
 OutputLRStructureElement(srt_item, depth);
 } else if ([item isGraphicsObjectElement]) {
 FSLRGraphicsObjectElement* srt_item = [[FSLRGraphicsObjectElement alloc] initWithElement:item];
 OutputLRStructureElement(srt_item, depth);
 }
 }
}

void outputAllLRElement(FSLRStructureElement* element) {
 NSFileHandle* text_doc = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForWritingAtPath:info_path];
 if (![element isEmpty]) {
 showLRElementInfo(element, 0);
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 NSString* info_file = @"layout_recognition_info.txt";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSPDFPage* original_page = [doc getPage:0];
 [original_page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:false];
 FSLRContext* context = [[FSLRContext alloc] initWithPage:original_page];
 FSProgressive* progressive = [context startParse:nil];
 FSLRStructureElement* root = [context getRootElement];
 FSLRElementElementType type = [root getElementType];
 int nElemListSize = [root getChildCount];
 outputAllLRElement(root, info_file);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return is_run_success? 0 : 1;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to create Remove text objects.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"graphics_objects.pdf";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 // Remove text objects from PDF page.
 page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSTextPageParseTextNormal pause:nil is_reparse:false];
 position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeAll];
 while(position > 0){
 FSGraphicsObject *obj = [page getGraphicsObject:position];
 if([obj getType] == FSGraphicsObjectTypeText){
 FSTextObject *textobj = [obj getTextObject];
 NSString *s = [textobj getText];
 if([s length] > 0){
 [page removeGraphicsObject:obj];
 position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeAll];
 continue;
 }
 }
 else if([obj getType] == FSGraphicsObjectTypeFormXObject){
 FSFormXObject *formxobj = [obj getFormXObject];
 FSGraphicsObjects *graphicsObjects_form = [formxobj getGraphicsObjects];
 long pos = [graphicsObjects_form getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 if(pos > 0){
 FSGraphicsObject *graphics_obj = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 FSTextObject *textobj = [graphics_obj getTextObject];
 if([textobj getType] == FSGraphicsObjectTypeText){
 NSString *s = [textobj getText];
 if([s length] > 0){
 [page removeGraphicsObject:obj];
 position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeAll];
 continue;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 position = [page getNextGraphicsObjectPosition:position filter:FSGraphicsObjectTypeAll];
 }
 [page generateContent];

 output_file = @"graphics_objects_remove_text_objects.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add radio form field.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddRadioForm(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Add radio button group
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Radio Button0" field_type:FSFieldTypeRadioButton rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50.0 bottom1:700 right1:90 top1:740]];
 FSControl *control1 = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Radio Button0" field_type:FSFieldTypeRadioButton rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100.0 bottom1:700 right1:140 top1:740]];

 control.exportValue = @"Yes";
 [control setChecked:YES];
 // Update radio button's appearance.
 [[control getWidget] resetAppearanceStream];

 control1.exportValue = @"NO";
 [control1 setChecked:NO];
 // Update radio button's appearance.
 [[control1 getWidget] resetAppearanceStream];

 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Create a blank new page and add radio form field into it.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 AddRadioForm(page, form);

 NSString *newPdf = @"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert gif files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert gif to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.gif";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_gif.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert gif to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.gif";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_gif_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert gif to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.gif";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_gif_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to generate barcode for different types.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

// Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
void save2Image(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

// Generate barcode in different type and save each of them as an image file.
void barcode_GenerateEachType(NSString *code_string, FSBarcodeFormat code_format, int unit_width, int unit_height, FSBarcodeQRErrorCorrectionLevel qr_level, NSString *file_path) {
 FSBarcode *barcode = [[FSBarcode alloc] init];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [barcode generateBitmap:code_string format:code_format unit_width:unit_width height:unit_height level:qr_level];
 save2Image(bitmap, file_path);
}

// Generate all types of barcode and save each of them as an image file.
void barcode_GenerateAll() {

 // Strings used as barcode content.
 NSArray *sz_code_string = [[NSArray alloc] initWithObjects:@"TEST-SHEET", @"102030405060708090", @"80674313", @"890444000335", @"9780804816632", @"070429", @"Unknown - change me!", @"TestForBarcodeQrCode", nil];

 // Barcode format types
 FSBarcodeFormat code_format[8] = {FSBarcodeFormatCode39, FSBarcodeFormatCode128, FSBarcodeFormatEAN8, FSBarcodeFormatUPCA, FSBarcodeFormatEAN13, FSBarcodeFormatITF, FSBarcodeFormatPDF417, FSBarcodeFormatQRCode};

 // Image names for the saved image files.(except QR code)
 NSArray *sz_bmp_name = [[NSArray alloc] initWithObjects:@"/code39_TEST-SHEET.bmp", @"/CODE_128_102030405060708090.bmp", @"/EAN_8_80674313.bmp", @"/UPC_A_890444000335.bmp", @"/EAN_13_9780804816632.bmp", @"/ITF_070429.bmp", @"/PDF_417_Unknown.bmp", nil];

 // Format error correction level of QR code.
 FSBarcodeQRErrorCorrectionLevel sz_qr_level[4] = {FSBarcodeQRCorrectionLevelLow, FSBarcodeQRCorrectionLevelMedium, FSBarcodeQRCorrectionLevelQuater, FSBarcodeQRCorrectionLevelHigh};

 // Image names for the saved image files for QR code.
 NSArray *bmp_qr_name = [[NSArray alloc] initWithObjects:@"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_L.bmp", @"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_M.bmp", @"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_Q.bmp", @"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_H.bmp", nil];

 // Unit width for barcode in pixels, preferred value is 1-5 pixels.
 int unit_width = 2;
 // Unit height for barcode in pixels, preferred value is >= 20 pixels.
 int unit_height = 120;

 // Generate barcode for different types.
 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
 if (code_format[i] != FSBarcodeFormatQRCode) {
 // Not QR code
 barcode_GenerateEachType([sz_code_string objectAtIndex:i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, (FSBarcodeQRErrorCorrectionLevel) 0, [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", [sz_bmp_name objectAtIndex:i]]);
 } else {
 // QR code
 // Generate for each format error correction level.
 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
 barcode_GenerateEachType([sz_code_string objectAtIndex:i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, sz_qr_level[j], [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", [bmp_qr_name objectAtIndex:j]]);
 }
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Generate all types of barcode
 barcode_GenerateAll();
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get sound annotation and save to file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"sound.pdf";
 NSString* file_path = @"sound.wav";
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 [doc load:nil];
 FSPDFPage* pdf_page = [doc getPage:0];
 if ([pdf_page isEmpty])
 {
 return NULL;
 }

 int annot_index_with_type = 0;
 int annot_index_with_all = 0;
 FSAnnot* annot = GetAnnotWithType(pdf_page, FSAnnotSound, annot_index_with_type, annot_index_with_all);
 if ([annot isEmpty]) {
 return NULL;
 }
 if ([annot getType] != FSAnnotSound) {
 return NULL;
 }
 FSSound* sound = [[FSSound alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 // save sound to file
 if ([sound isEmpty]) {
 return NO;
 }
 FSPDFStream *soundStream = [sound getSoundStream];
 NSMutableData *data = [NSMutableData dataWithData:[soundStream getData:NO]];
 NSFileManager *defaultManager = [NSFileManager defaultManager];

 if (![defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:[file_path stringByDeletingLastPathComponent]]) {
 [defaultManager createDirectoryAtPath:[file_path stringByDeletingLastPathComponent] withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:nil];
 }

 NSMutableData *randomAccessFile = [NSMutableData data];
 uint64_t streamSize = [soundStream getDataSize:NO];

 short bit = (short) sound.getBits;

 uint64_t riffSize = streamSize + 36;

 NSUInteger lInt = 4;
 NSUInteger sInt = 2;

 [randomAccessFile appendData:[@"RIFF" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]];
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&riffSize length:lInt];
 [randomAccessFile appendData:[@"WAVEfmt " dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]];

 NSUInteger chunkSize = 16;
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&chunkSize length:lInt];

 short format = 1;
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&format length:sInt];

 short channelCount = sound.getChannelCount;
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&channelCount length:sInt];

 int64_t rate = (int64_t)sound.getSamplingRate;
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&rate length:lInt];

 int64_t bytePerSec = rate * channelCount * bit / 8;
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&bytePerSec length:lInt];

 short blockAlign = (short) (bit * channelCount / 8);
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&blockAlign length:sInt];
 [randomAccessFile appendBytes:&bit length:sInt];
 [randomAccessFile appendData:[@"data" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]];

 BOOL ret = NO;
 NSUInteger encodingFormat = sound.getSampleEncodingFormat;
 switch (encodingFormat) {
 case FSSoundSampleEncodingFormatALaw:
 break;
 case FSSoundSampleEncodingFormatMuLaw:
 break;
 case FSSoundSampleEncodingFormatSigned:
 {
 NSMutableData *buffer = [NSMutableData data];
 int j = 0, k = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < streamSize; i += 2) {
 NSData *low = [data subdataWithRange:NSMakeRange(j++, 1)];
 NSData *high = [data subdataWithRange:NSMakeRange(j++, 1)];
 [buffer replaceBytesInRange:NSMakeRange(k++, 1) withBytes:high.bytes];
 [buffer replaceBytesInRange:NSMakeRange(k++, 1) withBytes:low.bytes];
 }
 [randomAccessFile appendData:buffer];
 ret = YES;
 }
 break;
 case FSSoundSampleEncodingFormatRaw:
 default:
 {
 [randomAccessFile appendData:data];
 ret = YES;
 }
 break;
 }

 return [randomAccessFile writeToFile:file_path atomically:YES];

 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to move annotation to new position in PDF coordinate system
```objective-c
#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_name = @"input_file.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_name];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 int fDelta = 10;
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 NSInteger iAnnotCount = [page getAnnotCount];
 for (NSInteger j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++) {
 FSAnnot* pAnnot = [page getAnnot:j];
 FSAnnotType annotType = [pAnnot getType];
 FSRectF* rect = [pAnnot getRect];
 FSRectF* newRect = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 newRect.left = orgRect.left;
 newRect.bottom = orgRect.bottom;
 if (FSAnnotPopup != annotType) {
 newRect.left += fDelta;
 newRect.bottom += fDelta;
 }
 newRect.right = orgRect.right + fDelta;
 newRect.top = orgRect.top + fDelta;
 [pAnnot move:newRect];
 }
 [doc saveAs:@"output_file.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 }
}

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_name];

 return -1;
 }

 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:5.0f y:5.0];

 int height = static_cast<int>([page getHeight]);
 FSMatrix2D *matrix = [page getDisplayMatrix:0 top:0 width:width height:height rotate:FSRotation0];
 FSAnnot* anot = [page getAnnotAtDevicePoint:point tolerance:0.0f, matrix:matrix];
 } @catch (NSException *e) {

How to use Foxit PDF SDk to add a polygon annotation.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 // Add polygon annotation, as cloud.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:300 bottom1:650 right1:500 top1:750];
 FSPolygon* polygon = [[FSPolygon alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotPolygon rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [polygon setFlags:4];
 [polygon setIntent:@"PolygonCloud"];
 [polygon setFillColor:0x0000FF];
 FSPointFArray* vertex_array = [FSPointFArray new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:335 y:665];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:365 y:665];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:385 y:705];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:365 y:740];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:335 y:740];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [point set:315 y:705];
 [vertex_array add:point];
 [polygon setVertexes:vertex_array];
 [polygon setSubject:@"Cloud"];
 [polygon setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [polygon setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [polygon setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [polygon setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [polygon resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a polygon annotation.");
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

void AddInteractiveForms(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Add text field, with flag password.
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Text Field5" field_type:FSFieldTypeTextField rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:200.0 bottom1:570 right1:240 top1:590]];

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using Foxit DRM security method.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

@interface DRMSecurityEvent : NSObject <FSDRMSecurityCallback>

@property (nonatomic, copy) NSString *fileID;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSData *initializeKey;

@end

@implementation DRMSecurityEvent

- (id)initWithFileID:(NSString *)fileID initializeKey:(NSData *)initializeKey {
	if (self = [super init]) {
 self.fileID = fileID;
 self.initializeKey = initializeKey;
	}
	return self;
}

- (FSPDFDocEncryptType)GetSecurityType {
	return FSPDFDocEncryptFoxitDRM;
}

- (FSSecurityHandlerCipherType)getCipherType:(FSPDFDoc *)document sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter {
	return FSSecurityHandlerCipherAES;
}

- (NSString *)getFileID:(FSPDFDoc *)document sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter {
	return self.fileID;
}

- (NSData *)getInitialKey:(FSPDFDoc *)document sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter {
	return self.initializeKey;
}

- (int)getKeyLength:(FSPDFDoc *)document sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter {
	return 16;
}

- (unsigned int)getUserPermissions:(FSPDFDoc *)document sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter {
	return 0xFFFFFFFC;
}

- (BOOL)isOwner:(FSPDFDoc *)document sub_filter:(NSString *)sub_filter {
	return TRUE;
}

@end

bool FoxitDRMDecrypt(NSString *input_file) {
	@try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 // Do encryption.
 FSDRMSecurityHandler *handler = [[FSDRMSecurityHandler alloc] init];
 NSString *file_id = @"Simple-DRM-file-ID";
 NSData *initialize_key = [@"Simple-DRM-initialize-key" dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 FSDRMEncryptData *encrypt_data = [[FSDRMEncryptData alloc] initWithIs_encrypt_metadata:YES sub_filter:@"Simple-DRM-filter" cipher:FSSecurityHandlerCipherAES key_length:16 is_owner:YES user_permissions:0xfffffffc];
 [handler initialize:encrypt_data file_id:file_id initial_key:initialize_key];
 [doc setSecurityHandler:handler];

 NSString *output_file = @"foxit_drm_encrypt.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 // Do decryption.
 DRMSecurityEvent *callback = [[DRMSecurityEvent alloc] initWithFileID:file_id initializeKey:initialize_key];
 [FSLibrary registerSecurityCallback:@"FoxitDRM" callback:callback];
 FSPDFDoc *encrypted_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:output_file];
 code = [encrypted_doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", encrypted_doc, (int)code);
 return false;
 }

 output_file = @"foxit_drm_decrypt.pdf";

 [encrypted_doc removeSecurity];
 [encrypted_doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 [FSLibrary unregisterSecurityCallback:@"FoxitDRM"];
	}
	@catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return false;
	}

	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 if (!FoxitDRMDecrypt(input_file)) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add bookmarks for PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 NSString *output_file = @"bookmark_add.pdf";

 @try {

 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", input_file, (int)code);
 return 1;
 }

 // Create new bookmark root node.
 FSBookmark *root = [doc getRootBookmark];
 if ([root isEmpty]) {
 root = [doc createRootBookmark];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < [doc getPageCount]; i += 2) {
 FSDestination *dest = [FSDestination createFitPage:doc page_index:i];
 NSString *title = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"A bookmark to a page (index: %d)", i];
 FSBookmark *child = [root insert:title position:FSBookmarkPosLastChild];
 [child setDestination:dest];
 [child setColor:i * 0xF68C21];
 }
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add single watermark into PDF files.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void addSingleWatermark(FSPDFDoc* doc, FSPDFPage* page) {
 FSWatermarkSettings* settings = [FSWatermarkSettings new];
 settings.flags = FSWatermarkSettingsFlagASPageContents|FSWatermarkSettingsFlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0.f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.f;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = FSPosBottomRight;
 settings.rotation = 0.0f;
 settings.scale_x = 0.1f;
 settings.scale_y = 0.1f;

 FSWatermark* watermark = [[FSWatermark alloc] initWithDocument:doc page:page settings:settings];
 [watermark insertToPage:page];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 addSingleWatermark(doc, page);
 }
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"watermark_add.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert bmp files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert bmp to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.bmp";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_bmp.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert bmp to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.bmp";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_bmp_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert bmp to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.bmp";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_bmp_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to detect the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin for bitmap.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"Foxit.bmp";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Detect the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin.
 rect = [bitmap detectBBoxByColorDiffer:20 color_differ:64];
 if ([rect height] > 0 && [rect width] > 0) {
 FSBitmap *clone_bitmap = [bitmap clone:rect];
 output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", @"calculate_bbox_by_color_differ_20_64_foxit.bmp"];
 saveBitmap(clone_bitmap, output_file);
 } else {
 NSLog(@"[Warning] The result of bounding box (according to the given background color) is an empty rectangle.");
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PDF page organization such as removing.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

bool RemovePage() {
	NSString *input_file = @"page_organization_123.pdf";
	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}

	while ([doc getPageCount] > 1) {
 [doc removePage:0];
	}
	NSString *output_file = @"remove_all_pages_exceptt_the_last_page.pdf";
	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
	NSLog(@"Remove pages.");
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 if (!RemovePage()) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to remove attached files from PDF files

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

NSString *DateTimeToString(const FSDateTime *datetime) {
 NSString *s_datetime = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%d/%d/%d-%d:%d:%d %@%d:%d", datetime.year, datetime.month, datetime.day, datetime.hour, datetime.minute, datetime.second, datetime.utc_hour_offset > 0 ? @"+" : @"-", datetime.utc_hour_offset, datetime.utc_minute_offset];
 return s_datetime;
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 {
 // Remove all attachments
 FSAttachments *attachment = [[FSAttachments alloc] initWithDoc:doc nametree:[[FSPDFNameTree alloc] init]];
 [attachment removeAllEmbeddedFiles];
 NSString *newPdf = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@attachment_remove.pdf", output_directory];
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 NSLog(@"Remove all attachments.");
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to get associate files in annot dictionary

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AF_Catalog_Page_Annot.pdf"

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page getAnnot:0];
 FSPDFDictionary *annot_dict = [annot getDict];
 count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCount:annot_dict];
 filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:annot_dict index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile::@"af_4.txt"];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to transform bitmap.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"Foxit.bmp";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Transform bitmap.
 int left, top;
 FSMatrix2D *matrix = [[FSMatrix2D alloc] initWithA1:width * 2.0f b1:0.f c1:0.f d1:height / 2.0f e1:0.f f1:0.f];
 FSBitmap *transform_bitmap = [bitmap transformTo:matrix flag:FSBitmapDownsample out_left:&left out_top:&top clip_rect:nil];
 output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", @"transform_bitmap_Foxit.bmp"];
 saveBitmap(transform_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"Annot_all.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"AnnotationSummary_generate.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 FSAnnotationSummary* commentssummary = [[FSAnnotationSummary alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 FSAnnotationSummarySettings* settings = [[FSAnnotationSummarySettings alloc] init];

 [settings setSortType:FSAnnotationSummarySettingsTypeSortByPage];
 [settings setAnnotType:FSAnnotUnknownType use_all:true];
 [settings setFileTitle:@"AnnotationSummaryFileTitle"];
 [settings enableOutputNoAnnotationPage:true];
 [settings setConnectorLineColor:0xFFFF22];
 [settings setConnectorLineOpacity:0.5f];

 [commentssummary startSummarize:save_pdf_path settings:settings pause:nil];
 NSLog(@"Generate annotation's summary to pdf successfully.");
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
	}

How to get associate files in Marked Content

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AF_Catalog_Page_Annot.pdf"

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 input_file = @"AF_MarkedContent.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 long pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSGraphicsObject *text_object = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 int count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCountWithGraphicsObject:text_object];
 FSFileSpec *filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFileWithGraphicsObject:text_object index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"bitmap.bmp"];

 filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFileWithGraphicsObject:text_object index:1];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"text.txt"];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a attachment annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add file attachment annotation
 NSString* pdf_path = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"AboutFoxit.pdf"];
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:280 bottom1:350 right1:300 top1:380];
 FSFileAttachment* file_attachment = [[FSFileAttachment alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotFileAttachment rect:annot_rect]];
 [file_attachment setIconName:@"Graph"];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [file_attachment setFlags:4];
 FSFileSpec* file_spec = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:[page getDocument]];
 [file_spec setFileName:@"attachment.pdf"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [file_spec setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [file_spec setDescription:@"The original file"];
 [file_spec setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [file_spec embed:pdf_path];
 [file_attachment setFileSpec:file_spec];
 [file_attachment setSubject:@"File Attachment"];
 [file_attachment setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [file_attachment resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add an attachment annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to enumerate and modify bookmarks in PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void ShowBookmarkInfo(FSBookmark *bookmark, NSMutableString *info, int depth) {
	if (depth > 32)
 return;
	if ([bookmark isEmpty]) {
 return;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
 NSLog(@"\t");
	}
	NSLog(@"%@", [bookmark getTitle] ?: @"");
	NSLog(@"%@", [NSString stringWithFormat:@"\tcolor: 0x%x\n", [bookmark getColor]]);
	ShowBookmarkInfo([bookmark getFirstChild], info, depth + 1);
	ShowBookmarkInfo([bookmark getNextSibling], info, depth);
}

void ShowBookmarksInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
	NSMutableString *info = [NSMutableString new];
	FSBookmark *root = [doc getRootBookmark];
	if (![root isEmpty]) {
 ShowBookmarkInfo(root, info, 0);
	} else {
 NSLog(@"No bookmark information!\n");
	}
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {

 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", input_file, (int)code);
 return 1;
 }

 // Show original bookmark information.
 ShowBookmarksInfo(doc);

 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert from DWG files to PDF files.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }
 NSString *dwg_file_path = @"ParcelMap.dwg";
 // "engine_path" is the path of the engine file "dwg2pdf" which is used to convert dwg to pdf. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 NSString *engine_path = @"";
 NSString *output_file_path = @"dwg2pdf_result.pdf";

 @try {
 // Setting DWG2PDFSettingData values.
 FSDWG2PDFSettingData *settings=[FSDWG2PDFSettingData new];
 settings.export_flags = FSDWG2PDFSettingDataFlagZoomToExtentsMode;
 settings.export_hatches_type = FSDWG2PDFSettingDataDWG2PDFExportHatchesTypeBitmap;
 settings.other_export_hatches_type = FSDWG2PDFSettingDataDWG2PDFExportHatchesTypeBitmap;
 settings.gradient_export_hatches_type = FSDWG2PDFSettingDataDWG2PDFExportHatchesTypeBitmap;
 settings.searchable_text_type = FSDWG2PDFSettingDataDWG2PDFSearchableTextTypeNoSearch;
 settings.is_active_layout = true;
 settings.paper_width = 650;
 settings.paper_height = 850;
 settings.output_title = @"DWG2PDF";
 settings.output_author = @"Cad Artist";
 settings.output_subject = @"Cad Subject";
 settings.output_keywords = @"DWG2PDF";
 settings.output_creator = @"Dwg Artist";
 settings.output_producer = @"FoxitSDK";
 // Convert DWG file to PDF file.
 [FSConvert fromDWG:engine_path src_dwg_path:dwg_file_path saved_pdf_path:output_file_path settings:settings];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
}

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

	@autoreleasepool {

 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"/Users/xxx/Desktop/test.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld", input_pdf_path, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFNameTree* templates_name_tree = [[FSPDFNameTree alloc] initWithDocument:doc type:FSPDFNameTreeTemplates];
 if ([templates_name_tree hasName:@"Page3"]) {
 [doc addPageFromTemplate: @"Page3"];
 }
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"/Users/xxx/Desktop/add_test_template.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to make multiple signatures share signature data.
#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_name = @"blank.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_name];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 FSRectF *sigRect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:0 bottom1:400 right1:200 top1:475];
 FSSignature* pNewSig = [page addSignature:sigRect];
 [pNewSig setKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameSigner value:@"Neko");
 [pNewSig setKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameReason value:@"For test");
 [pNewSig generateAppearance];
 FSRectF *sigRect1 = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:200 bottom1:200 right1:400 top1:275];
 FSSignature* sign1 = [page addSignatureWithExistedVDict:sigRect1 field_name:@"test1" signature_type:FSSignatureSignatureTypeOrdinary to_check_permission:false existed_signature:pNewSig];
 [pNewSig setKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameSigner value:@"Jack");
 [pNewSig setKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameReason value:@"For test GSDK");
 [sign1 generateAppearance];
 NSString *cert_file_path = @"foxit_all.pfx";
 NSString *cert_file_password = @"123456";
 [pNewSig startSign:cert_file_path cert_password:cert_file_password digest_algorithm:FSSignatureDigestSHA1 save_path:@"Signed.pdf" client_data:nil pause:nil);
 } @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 }
}

---

How to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of replace text type.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* rime = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(rime->tm_year + 1900) month:(rime->tm_mon + 1) day:(rime->tm_mday) hour:(rime->tm_hour) minute:(rime->tm_min) second:(rime->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

void createSquigglyRect(FSPDFPage* page, FSRectFArray* rects, int color, NSString *csContents, NSString *csType, NSString *csObjType) {
	if (rects == NULL) return;
	int rectSize = [rects getSize];
	if (rectSize == 0) return;
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 FSSquiggly* squiggly = [[FSSquiggly alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotSquiggly rect:annot_rect]];
 [squiggly setContent:csContents];

 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];

 for (int i=0; i<rectSize; i++)
 {
 FSRectF* item = [rects getAt:i];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:item.left y:item.top];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:item.right y:item.top];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:item.left y:item.bottom];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:item.right y:item.bottom];
 quad_points.fourth = point;

 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 }
 [squiggly setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];

 [squiggly setBorderColor:color];
 [squiggly setSubject:csObjType];
 [squiggly setTitle:csType];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [squiggly setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [squiggly setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [squiggly setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 [squiggly resetAppearanceStream];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *base_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_base_file];
 errorCode = [base_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSPDFDoc *compared_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_compared_file];
 errorCode = [compared_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSComparison* comparison = [[FSComparison alloc] initWithBase_doc:base_doc compared_doc:compared_doc];
 FSCompareResults* result = [comparison doCompare:0 compared_page_index:0 compare_flags:FSComparisonCompareTypeText];
 int oldInfoSize = [result.base_doc_results getSize];
 FSPDFPage* page1 = [base_doc getPage:0];
 for (int i=0; i<oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 FSCompareResultInfo* item = [result.compared_doc_results getAt:i];
 FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultTypeReplaceText)
 {
 NSString* res_string = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"[Old]: \"%@\"\r\n[New]: \"%@\"",[result.base_doc_results getAt:i].diff_contents,item.diff_contents];
 createSquigglyRect(page1, item.rect_array, 0xe7651a, res_string, @"Compare : Replace", @"Text");
 }
 }
 FSPDFDoc* new_doc = [comparison generateComparedDoc:FSComparisonCompareTypeAll];
 [new_doc saveAs:@"generate_result.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a text box freetext annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {

 switch (n) {

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation, as text box.

 //This flag is used for printing annotations.

 FSDefaultAppearance* default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:da_flags font:da_font text_size:12.0 text_color:0x000000];

 [freetext setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a text box freetext annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to get associate files in image objects or form objects.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AF_ImageXObject_FormXObject.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 long pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeImage];
 FSGraphicsObject *image_x_object = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 FSPDFDictionary *image_x_object_dict = [[[image_x_object getImageObject] getStream] getDictionary];
 int count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCount:image_x_object_dict];

 FSFileSpec *filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:image_x_object_dict index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"af_5.txt"];

 pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeFormXObject];
 FSGraphicsObject *form_x_object = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 FSPDFDictionary *form_x_object_dict = [[[form_x_object getFormXObject] getStream] getDictionary];
 count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCount:form_x_object_dict];
 filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:form_x_object_dict index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile:"af_6.txt"];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert tif files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert tif to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.tif";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_tif.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert tif to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.tif";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_tif_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert tif to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.tif";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_tif_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

---

How to use matrix to translate, scale objects

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"SamplePDF.pdf";
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [doc load:@""];
 if (error_code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 // Get and parse page.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 long pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeAll];
 int flag = 0;
 while (pos != 0) {
 if (flag == (2 | 4))
 break;
 FSGraphicsObject *obj = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 pos = [page getNextGraphicsObjectPosition:pos filter:FSGraphicsObjectTypeAll];
 FSGraphicsObjectType type = [obj getType];
 float start_x = 0;
 // Get one TextObject or one ImageObject.
 if (type == FSGraphicsObjectTypeText && !(flag & 2)) {
 start_x = 400.0f;
 flag |= 2;
 } else if (type == FSGraphicsObjectTypeImage && !(flag & 4)) {
 start_x = 150.0f;
 flag |= 4;
 } else {
 continue;
 }

 // Now we have found the TextObject or the ImageObject, transform them.
 FSGraphicsObject *clone_obj1 = [obj clone];
 FSMatrix2D *matrix = clone_obj1.matrix;
 // Translate the matrix in vertical direction.
 [matrix translate:0 y:150 bPrepended:0];
 clone_obj1.matrix = matrix;
 [page insertGraphicsObject:0 graphics_object:clone_obj1];

 FSGraphicsObject *clone_obj2 = [obj clone];
 matrix = clone_obj2.matrix;
 float d = matrix.d;
 float e = matrix.e;
 float f = matrix.f;
 // Translate it to the original point(0,0) first
 [matrix translate:-e y:-f bPrepended:0];
 // Rotate the matrix 90 degree in anticlockwise direction.
 [matrix rotate:1.57f bPrepended:0];
 // Page rotation should be considered, assume that the current page rotation is 0.
 float distance = d;
 if (type == FSGraphicsObjectTypeText) {
 FSRectF *obj_rect = [obj getRect];
 distance = obj_rect.top - obj_rect.bottom;
 }
 // Translate it to the specific coordinate(start_x,400)
 [matrix translate:distance + start_x y:400 bPrepended:0];
 clone_obj2.matrix = matrix;
 [page insertGraphicsObject:0 graphics_object:clone_obj2];

 FSGraphicsObject *clone_obj3 = [obj clone];
 matrix = clone_obj3.matrix;
 // Translate it to the original point(0,0) first
 [matrix translate:-e y:-f bPrepended:0];
 // Magnify the matrix 1.5 times in both horizontal and vertical directions.
 [matrix scale:1.5 sy:1.5 bPrepended:0];
 // Translate it to the specific coordinate(start_x,600)
 [matrix translate:start_x y:600.0f bPrepended:0];
 clone_obj3.matrix = matrix;
 [page insertGraphicsObject:0 graphics_object:clone_obj3];

 FSGraphicsObject *clone_obj4 = [obj clone];
 matrix = clone_obj4.matrix;
 // Translate it to the original point(0,0) first
 [matrix translate:-e y:-f bPrepended:0];
 // Skews the x axis by an angle 0.5 and the y axis by an angle 0.5.
 [matrix shear:0.5 fBetaRadian:0.5 bPrepended:0];
 // Translate it to the specific coordinate(start_x,600)
 [matrix translate:start_x y:800.0f bPrepended:0];
 clone_obj4.matrix = matrix;
 [page insertGraphicsObject:0 graphics_object:clone_obj4];
 }
 // Generate the page content
 [page generateContent];

 // Save the pdf document
 NSString *file_name = @"MatrixTransformResult.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:file_name save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to continuous reflow PDF pages.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap* bitmap, int index, NSString* save_file_name) {
 FSRectF* margin = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50 bottom1:30 right1:30 top1:30];
 FSPointF* size = [FSPointF new];
 [size set:480 y:800];
 FSRectI* rect = [[FSRectI alloc] initWithLeft1:0 top1:0 right1:(int)size.x bottom1:(int)margin.top];

 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:rect];
 rect = [[FSRectI alloc] initWithLeft1:0 top1:(int)(size.y - margin.bottom) right1:(int)size.x bottom1:(int)size.y];
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:rect];
 FSImage* image = [FSImage new];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];

 NSString* save_file_path = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@%@%d.bmp", output_directory, @"reflow", save_file_name, index];
 [image saveAs:save_file_path];
}

// Fixed bitmap size, just to simulate split screen situation.
void reflowContinuous(FSPDFDoc* doc) {
 FSRectF* margin = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50 bottom1:30 right1:30 top1:30];
 FSPointF* size = [FSPointF new];
 [size set:480 y:800];
 float display_height = size.y - margin.top - margin.bottom;
 FSBitmap* bitmap = [[FSBitmap alloc] initWithWidth:(int)size.x height:(int)size.y format:FSBitmapDIBArgb buffer:nil pitch:0];
 float offset_y = 0;
 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 int bitmap_index = 0;
 for(int i=0;i<page_count;i++)
 {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];

 // Parse PDF page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 FSReflowPage* reflow_page = [[FSReflowPage alloc] initWithPage:page];
 // Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow page.
 [reflow_page setLineSpace:0];
 [reflow_page setScreenMargin:(int)margin.left top:(int)margin.top right:(int)margin.right bottom:(int)margin.bottom];
 [reflow_page setScreenSize:size.x height:size.y];
 [reflow_page setZoom:100];
 [reflow_page setParseFlags:FSReflowPageWithImage];

 [reflow_page setTopSpace:offset_y];

 // Parse reflow page.
 [reflow_page startParse:nil];

 // Get actual size of content of reflow page.
 // The content size does not contain the margin but contains the top space.
 float content_height = [reflow_page getContentHeight];
 float content_width = [reflow_page getContentWidth];
 // Render reflow page.
 FSRenderer* renderer = [[FSRenderer alloc] initWithBitmap:bitmap is_rgb_order:NO];
 FSMatrix2D* matrix = [reflow_page getDisplayMatrix:0 offset_y:0 width:(int)content_width height:(int)content_height rotate:0];
 [renderer startRenderReflowPage:reflow_page matrix:matrix pause:nil];

 int rate_need_screen_count = static_cast<int>(ceil(MAX(content_height - display_height, 0.0f) / display_height));
 if (rate_need_screen_count > 0) {
 // Before do next rendering, save current bitmap first.
 NSString* file_name = @"_continuous_";
 saveBitmap(bitmap, bitmap_index++,file_name);

 float has_display_height = display_height;
 for (int j = 0; j < rate_need_screen_count; j++) {
 // Clear the bitmap and used it to do next rendering.
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:nil];
 // Render reflow page.
 FSRenderer* renderer = [[FSRenderer alloc] initWithBitmap:bitmap is_rgb_order:NO];
 FSMatrix2D* matrix = [reflow_page getDisplayMatrix:0 offset_y:-has_display_height width:(int)content_width height:(int)content_height rotate:0];
 [renderer startRenderReflowPage:reflow_page matrix:matrix pause:nil];
 if (j != rate_need_screen_count - 1) {
 has_display_height += display_height;
 saveBitmap(bitmap, bitmap_index++,file_name);
 } else {
 offset_y = content_height - rate_need_screen_count * display_height;
 }
 }
 } else {
 offset_y = content_height;
 }
 }
 NSString* file_name = @"_continuous_";
 saveBitmap(bitmap, bitmap_index++,file_name);
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 reflowContinuous(doc);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}
