How to use Foxit PDF SDK to stretch bitmap.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"Foxit.bmp";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Stretch bitmap.
 FSBitmap *stretch_bitmap = [bitmap stretchTo:width / 2 dest_height:height / 2 flag:FSBitmapDownsample clip_rect:nil];
 NSString *output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", @"stetch_bitmap_Foxit.bmp"];
 saveBitmap(stretch_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add combox form field

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddInteractiveForms(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Add combo box
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Combo Box0" field_type:FSFieldTypeComboBox rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50.0 bottom1:350 right1:350 top1:400]];
 FSField *field = [control getField];
 FSChoiceOptionArray *options = [[FSChoiceOptionArray alloc] init];
 [options add:[[FSChoiceOption alloc] initWithOption_value:@"Foxit SDK" option_label:@"Foxit SDK" selected:YES default_selected:YES]];
 [options add:[[FSChoiceOption alloc] initWithOption_value:@"Foxit Reader" option_label:@"Foxit Reader" selected:YES default_selected:YES]];
 [options add:[[FSChoiceOption alloc] initWithOption_value:@"Foxit Phantom" option_label:@"Foxit Phantom" selected:YES default_selected:YES]];
 field.options = options;

 FSWidget *widget = [control getWidget];
 widget.mKBorderColor = 0x000000;
 widget.mKBackgroundColor = 0xFFFFFF;
 [widget resetAppearanceStream];

 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Create a blank new page and add combo box form field.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];

 AddInteractiveForms(page, form);

 NSString *newPdf = @"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to single reflow PDF pages.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap* bitmap, int index, NSString* save_file_name) {
 FSRectF* margin = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50 bottom1:30 right1:30 top1:30];
 FSPointF* size = [FSPointF new];
 [size set:480 y:800];
 FSRectI* rect = [[FSRectI alloc] initWithLeft1:0 top1:0 right1:(int)size.x bottom1:(int)margin.top];

 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:rect];
 rect = [[FSRectI alloc] initWithLeft1:0 top1:(int)(size.y - margin.bottom) right1:(int)size.x bottom1:(int)size.y];
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:rect];
 FSImage* image = [FSImage new];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];

 NSString* save_file_path = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@%@%d.bmp", output_directory, @"reflow", save_file_name, index];
 [image saveAs:save_file_path];
}

// The change for the size of the picture depends on the size of the content of reflow page.
void reflowSingle(FSPDFDoc* doc) {
 FSRectF* margin = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50 bottom1:30 right1:30 top1:30];
 FSPointF* size = [FSPointF new];
 [size set:480 y:800];
 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i=0;i<page_count;i++) {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse PDF page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 FSReflowPage* reflow_page = [[FSReflowPage alloc] initWithPage:page];
 // Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow page.
 [reflow_page setLineSpace:0];
 [reflow_page setScreenMargin:margin.left top:(int)margin.top right:(int)margin.right bottom:(int)margin.bottom];
 [reflow_page setScreenSize:size.x height:size.y];
 [reflow_page setZoom:100];
 [reflow_page setParseFlags:FSReflowPageNormal];

 // Parse reflow page.
 [reflow_page startParse:nil];

 // Get actual size of content of reflow page. The content size does not contain the margin.
 float content_width = [reflow_page getContentWidth];
 float content_height = [reflow_page getContentHeight];

 // Create a bitmap for rendering the reflow page. The bitmap size contains the margin.
 FSBitmap* bitmap = [[FSBitmap alloc] initWithWidth:(int)(content_width + margin.left + margin.right) height:(int)(content_height + margin.top + margin.bottom) format:FSBitmapDIBArgb buffer:nil pitch:0];
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF rect:nil];

 // Render reflow page.
 FSRenderer* renderer = [[FSRenderer alloc] initWithBitmap:bitmap is_rgb_order:NO];
 FSMatrix2D* matrix = [reflow_page getDisplayMatrix:0 offset_y:0 width:(int)content_width height:(int)content_height rotate:0];
 [renderer startRenderReflowPage:reflow_page matrix:matrix pause:nil];
 NSString* file_name = @"_single_";
 saveBitmap(bitmap, i, file_name);
 }

}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 reflowSingle(doc);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PDF page organization such as import optimized.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

bool ImportPageOptimized() {
 NSString *file_dest = @"page_organization_123.pdf";
 NSString *file_src = @"page_organization_abc.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc *doc_dest = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:file_dest];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc_dest load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 FSPDFDoc *doc_src = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:file_src];
 code = [doc_src load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }
 // Extract pages to temporary document
 FSRange *import_ranges = [[FSRange alloc] initWithIndex:0];
 [import_ranges addSingle:[doc_src getPageCount] - 1];
 NSString *file_temp = @"page_organization_import_extracted_pages.pdf";
 FSProgressive *progressive = [doc_src startExtractPages:file_temp options:FSPDFDocExtractPagesOptionAnnotation page_range:import_ranges pause:nil];
 while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 ;
 }

 FSPDFDoc *doc_temp = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:file_temp];
 code = [doc_temp load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 // Insert temporary document into destination
 [doc_dest insertDocument:-1 src_doc:doc_temp options:FSPDFDocInsertDocOptionAttachments];
 NSString *output_file = @"abc_to_123_insert_document.pdf";
 [doc_dest saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 if (!ImportPageOptimized()) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {

 @catch (NSException *e) {

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a underline annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add underline annotation.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100 bottom1:450 right1:200 top1:550];
 FSUnderline* underline = [[FSUnderline alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotUnderline rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [underline setFlags:4];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:110 y:500];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:190 y:500];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:110 y:480];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:190 y:480];
 quad_points.fourth = point;
 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];
 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 [underline setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];
 [underline setSubject:@"Underline"];
 [underline setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [underline setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [underline setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [underline setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [underline resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a underline annotation.");
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PDF page organization such as importing.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

// You can implement the functionality of exporting pages by creating an empty document
// and importing part of the source document into the empty document.
// You can also import the target document as a source document
// to implement the copy page functionality.
bool ImportPage() {
	NSString *file_dest = @"page_organization_123.pdf";
	NSString *file_src = @"page_organization_abc.pdf";
	FSPDFDoc *doc_dest = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:file_dest];
	FSErrorCode code = [doc_dest load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}
	FSPDFDoc *doc_src = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:file_src];
	code = [doc_src load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}
	// Import page from PDFDoc object.
	FSRange *import_ranges = [[FSRange alloc] initWithIndex:0];
	[import_ranges addSingle:[doc_src getPageCount]-1];
	FSProgressive *progressive = [doc_dest startImportPages:-1 src_doc:doc_src flags:FSPDFDocImportFlagNormal layer_name:@"abc" page_range:import_ranges pause:nil];
	while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 ;
	}
	NSString *output_file = @"page_organization_abc_to_123_import_pages.pdf";
	[doc_dest saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

	doc_dest = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:file_dest];
	code = [doc_dest load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}
	// Import page from file path.
	progressive = [doc_dest startImportPagesFromFilePath:-1 src_file_path:file_src password:nil flags:FSPDFDocImportFlagNormal layer_name:@"abc" page_range:import_ranges pause:nil];
	while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 ;
	}
	output_file = @"abc_to_123_import_pages_form_filepath.pdf";
	[doc_dest saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 if (!ImportPage()) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to calculate the bounding box according to the given background color for bitmap.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"Foxit.bmp";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Calculate the bounding box according to the given background color.
 FSRectI *rect = [bitmap calculateBBoxByColor:0xFFFDFDFD];
 if ([rect height] > 0 && [rect width] > 0) {
 FSBitmap *clone_bitmap = [bitmap clone:rect];
 output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", @"calculate_bbox_by_color_0xFFFDFDFD_foxit.bmp"];
 saveBitmap(clone_bitmap, output_file);
 } else {
 NSLog(@"[Warning] The result of bounding box (according to the given background color) is an empty rectangle.");
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add bitmap watermark into PDF files.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void addBitmapWatermark(FSPDFDoc* doc, FSPDFPage* page, NSString* bitmap_file_path) {
 FSWatermarkSettings* settings = [FSWatermarkSettings new];
 settings.flags = FSWatermarkSettingsFlagASPageContents | FSWatermarkSettingsFlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0.f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.f;
 settings.opacity = 60;
 settings.position = FSPosCenterLeft;
 settings.rotation = 90.f;

 FSImage* image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:bitmap_file_path];
 FSBitmap* bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 settings.scale_x = [page getHeight] * 1.0f / [bitmap getWidth];
 settings.scale_y = settings.scale_x;

 FSWatermark* watermark = [[FSWatermark alloc] initWithDocument:doc bitmap:bitmap settings:settings];
 [watermark insertToPage:page];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 bool is_run_success = false;
 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 NSString* bmp_file_path = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@", input_path, @"watermark.bmp"];
 addBitmapWatermark(doc, page, bmp_file_path );
 }
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"watermark_add.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return is_run_success? 0 : 1;
 }

}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add text watermark into PDF files.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void addTextWatermark(FSPDFDoc* doc, FSPDFPage* page) {
 FSWatermarkSettings* settings = [FSWatermarkSettings new];
 settings.flags = FSWatermarkSettingsFlagASPageContents | FSWatermarkSettingsFlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0;
 settings.offset_y = 0;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = FSPosTopRight;
 settings.rotation = -45.f;
 settings.scale_x = 1.f;
 settings.scale_y = 1.f;

 FSWatermarkTextProperties* text_properties = [FSWatermarkTextProperties new];
 text_properties.alignment = FSAlignmentCenter;
 text_properties.color = 0xF68C21;
 text_properties.font_style = FSWatermarkTextPropertiesFontStyleNormal;
 text_properties.line_space = 1;
 text_properties.font_size = 12.f;
 FSFont* new_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDTimesB];
 text_properties.font = new_font;

 FSWatermark* watermark = [[FSWatermark alloc] initWithDocument:doc text:@"Foxit PDF SDK\nwww.foxitsoftware.com" properties:text_properties settings:settings];
 [watermark insertToPage:page];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 addTextWatermark(doc, page);
 }

 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"watermark_add.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }

}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PDF page organization such as inserting.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void AddTextObjects(FSPDFPage *page, NSString *content) {
	long position = [page getLastGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
	FSTextObject *text_object = [FSTextObject create];

	[text_object setFillColor:0xFFAAAAAA];
	[text_object setStrokeColor:0xFFF68C21];

	// Prepare text state
	FSTextState *state = [[FSTextState alloc] init];
	state.font_size = 64.0f;
	FSFont *font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDTimes];
	state.font = font;
	state.textmode = FSTextStateModeFillStrokeClip;

	[text_object setTextState:page text_state:state is_italic:NO weight:750];

	// Set content
	[text_object setText:content];
	[page insertGraphicsObject:position graphics_object:text_object];

	// Transform to center
	FSRectF *rect = [text_object getRect];
	float offset_x = ([page getWidth] - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
	float offset_y = ([page getHeight] - (rect.top - rect.bottom)) / 2;
	FSMatrix2D *matrix = [[FSMatrix2D alloc] initWithA1:1 b1:0 c1:0 d1:1 e1:offset_x f1:offset_y];
	[text_object transform:matrix need_transform_clippath:NO];

	// Generator content
	[page generateContent];
}

bool InsertPage() {
	NSString *input_file = @"page_organization_123.pdf";
	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}

	float w = 612.0;
	float h = 792.0;
	FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:-1 width:w height:h];
	AddTextObjects(page, @"insert in first");
	page = [doc insertPage:2 width:w height:h];
	AddTextObjects(page, @"insert in 2 (based 0)");
	page = [doc insertPage:[doc getPageCount] width:w height:h];
	AddTextObjects(page, @"insert in last");
	NSString *output_file = @"insert_page.pdf";
	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 if (!InsertPage()) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to recognize form in a PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString *input_file = "ElectricTable.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 [doc load:nil];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 int count = [form getFieldCount:@""];
 //Start to recognize form in current PDF document.
 [doc startRecognizeForm:nil];
 count = [form getFieldCount:nil];
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 FSField* field = [form getField:i filter:nil];
 NSString* str = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"NO.%d", i+1]; ;
 [field setValue:str];
 }
 NSString* newPdf = @"ElectricTable_StartRecognizeForm.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add image watermarks into PDF files.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void addImageWatermark(FSPDFDoc* doc, FSPDFPage* page, NSString* image_file_path) {
 FSWatermarkSettings* settings = [FSWatermarkSettings new];
 settings.flags = FSWatermarkSettingsFlagASPageContents | FSWatermarkSettingsFlagOnTop;
 settings.offset_x = 0.f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.f;
 settings.opacity = 20;
 settings.position = FSPosCenter;
 settings.rotation = 0.0f;

 FSImage* image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:image_file_path];
 FSBitmap* bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 settings.scale_x = [page getWidth] * 0.618f / [bitmap getWidth];
 settings.scale_y = settings.scale_x;

 FSWatermark* watermark = [[FSWatermark alloc] initWithDocument:doc image:image frame_index:0 settings:settings];
 [watermark insertToPage:page];
}

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;

 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {

 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 addImageWatermark(doc, page, image_file_path);

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a freetext annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation, as type writer.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:10 bottom1:550 right1:200 top1:600];
 FSFreeText* freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [freetext setFlags:4];
 // Set default appearance
 unsigned int da_flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 FSFont* da_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelvetica];
 FSDefaultAppearance* default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:da_flags font:da_font text_size:12.0 text_color:0x000000];
 // Set default appearance for form.
 [freetext setDefaultAppearance:default_ap];
 [freetext setIntent:@"FreeTextTypewriter"];
 [freetext setContent:@"A typewriter annotation"];
 [freetext setSubject:@"FreeTextTypewriter"];
 [freetext setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [freetext setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a typewriter freetext annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get annotation rectangle in device coordinate system.

```objective-c
#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_name = @"input_file.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_name];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 int width = (int)[page getWidth];
 int height = (int)[page getHeight];
 NSArray *bmpWidth = @[@(width), @(2 * width)];
 NSArray *bmpHeight = @[@(height), @(2 * height)];

 for (NSInteger i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
 FSMatrix2D *setMatrix = [page getDisplayMatrix:0 y:0 width:bmpWidth[i] height:bmpHeight[i] rotation:FSRotation0];
 NSInteger iAnnotCount = [page getAnnotCount];

 for (NSInteger j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++) {
 FSAnnot* pAnnot = [page getAnnot:j];
 FSRectI* deviceRect = [pAnnot getDeviceRect:setMatrix];
 }
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 }
}
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do encryption and decryption for a PDF file by using password security method.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

bool StdSecurity(NSString *input_file) {
	@try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 // Do encryption.
 FSStdSecurityHandler *handler = [[FSStdSecurityHandler alloc] init];
 FSStdEncryptData *encrypt_data = [[FSStdEncryptData alloc] initWithIs_encrypt_metadata:YES user_permissions:0xfffffffc cipher:FSSecurityHandlerCipherAES key_length:16];
 [handler initialize:encrypt_data user_password:@"user" owner_password:@"owner"];
 [doc setSecurityHandler:handler];

 NSString *output_file = @"std_encrypt_userpwd[user]_ownerpwd[owner].pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 // Do decryption.
 FSPDFDoc *encrypted_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:output_file];
 code = [encrypted_doc load:@"owner"];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
 }

 [encrypted_doc removeSecurity];
 output_file = @"std_decrypt.pdf";
 [encrypted_doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
	}
	@catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
	}
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 if (!StdSecurity(input_file)) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to export data, import data and reset form for XFA document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

@interface CFS_XFAAppHandler : NSObject<FSAppProviderCallback>

@end

	return @"Foxit SDK";
}

}

-(FSAppProviderCallbackMsgBoxButtonID)msgBox:(NSString*)message title:(NSString*)title icon_type: (FSAppProviderCallbackMsgBoxIconType) icon_type button_type: (FSAppProviderCallbackMsgBoxButtonType)button_type {
	return (FSAppProviderCallbackMsgBoxButtonID)0;
}

	return @"answer";
}

-(id<FSFileReaderCallback>)downLoadUrl:(NSString*)url {
	return nil;
}

	return @"PostRequestUrl";
}

-(BOOL)putRequestURL:(NSString*)url data:(NSString*)data encode:(NSString*)encode {
	return YES;
}

-(NSString*)loadString:(FSAppProviderCallbackStringID)string_id {
	return @"LoadString";
}

-(NSArray<NSString*>*)showFileDialog:(NSString*)string_title string_filter:(NSString*)string_filter is_openfile_dialog:(BOOL)is_openfile_dialog {
	return [NSArray<NSString*> alloc];
}

@end

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 CFS_XFAAppHandler* pXFAAppHandler = [CFS_XFAAppHandler alloc];
 [FSLibrary registerXFAAppProviderCallback:pXFAAppHandler];
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 CFS_XFADocHandler* pXFADocHandler = [CFS_XFADocHandler alloc];
 FSXFADoc* xfa_doc = [[FSXFADoc alloc] initWithDocument:doc xfa_doc_provider_handler:pXFADocHandler];
 [xfa_doc startLoad:nil];

 [xfa_doc exportData:@"xfa_form.xml" export_type:FSXFADocExportDataTypeXML];
 [xfa_doc resetForm];
 [doc saveAs:@"xfa_dynamic_resetform.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 [xfa_doc importData:@"xfa_form.xml"];
 [doc saveAs:@"xfa_dynamic_importdata.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert a PDF file to PDFA-1.7 version.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface MyComplianceProgressCallback : NSObject<FSComplianceProgressCallback>
{
}
-(id)init;
@end

@implementation MyComplianceProgressCallback

-(id)init {
	return self;
}

-(void)updateCurrentStateData: (int)current_rate current_state_string: (NSString*)current_state_string {
	NSLog(@"Current rate: %d", current_rate);
}

@end

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 NSString* compliance_resource_folder_path = @"";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for FSComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 NSString* compliance_engine_unlockcode = @"";

 if ([compliance_resource_folder_path length] < 1) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 errorCode = [FSComplianceEngine initialize:compliance_resource_folder_path compliance_engine_unlockcode:compliance_engine_unlockcode];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"1_pdfacompliance_convert_to_pdf17.pdf";
 {
 // Convert original PDF file to PDF-1.7 version.
 MyComplianceProgressCallback* convert_progress_callback = [[MyComplianceProgressCallback alloc] init];
 FSResultInformation* convert_result_info = [pdfa_compliance convertPDFFile:input_file saved_pdf_path:save_pdf_path convert_to_version:17 progress_callback:convert_progress_callback];
 }

 // Release compliance engine.
 [FSComplianceEngine destroy];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into annotation dictionary.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AF_Catalog_Page_Annot.pdf"

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FSFileSpec *filespec_txt = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_txt.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_txt.fileName = @"1.txt";
 FSDateTime *dateTime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:15 hour:17 minute:20 second:20 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 filespec_txt.description = @"text";
 [filespec_txt embed:@"1.txt"];
 filespec_txt.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 1.txt with annotation dictionary.
 FSRectF *rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100 bottom1:50 right1:220 top1:100];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotNote rect:rect];
 [associated_files associateFileWithAnnot:annot file_spec:filespec_txt];
 FSFileSpec *filespec_annot = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:[annot getDict] index:0];
 [filespec_annot exportToFile:@"annotation.txt"];

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add table of contents to PDF file.
#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_name = @"Bookmark.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_name];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSTableOfContentsConfig* toc_config = [FSTableOfContentsConfig new];
 toc_config.include_toc_pages = No;
 toc_config.title = @"Table of Contents";
 toc_config.is_show_serial_number = Yes;
 toc_config.bookmark_level_array = [FSInt32Array new];

 int depth = [doc getBookmarkLevelDepth];
 if (depth > 0) {
 if (depth > 5) depth = 5;
 for (int i = 1; i <= depth; i++) {
 [toc_config.bookmark_level_array add:i];
 }
 }
 [doc addTableOfContentsWithTableOfContentsConfig:toc_config];
 [doc saveAs:@"TOC.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 } @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do output preview.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 bool is_run_success = false;
 @try {
 NSString* pdf_path = @"page_organization_123.pdf";

 // "default_icc_folder_path" is the path of the folder which contains default icc profile files.
 NSString* default_icc_folder_path = @"";

 if ([default_icc_folder_path length] < 1) {
 return -1;
 }
 [FSLibrary setDefaultICCProfilesPath:default_icc_folder_path];

 FSPDFDoc *pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [pdf_doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFPage* pdf_page = [pdf_doc getPage:0];
 [pdf_page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 float page_width = [pdf_page getWidth];
 float page_height = [pdf_page getHeight];
 int width = (int)page_width;
 int height = (int)page_height;

 FSBitmapDIBFormat bitmap_format = FSBitmapDIBInvalid;
 unsigned int background_color = 0x000000;
 if ([pdf_page hasTransparency]) {
 background_color = 0x000000;
 bitmap_format = FSBitmapDIBArgb;
 } else {
 background_color = 0xFFFFFF;
 bitmap_format = FSBitmapDIBRgb32;
 }
 FSBitmap* bitmap = [[FSBitmap alloc] initWithWidth:width height:height format:bitmap_format buffer:nil pitch:0];
 [bitmap fillRect:background_color rect:nil];

 FSMatrix2D* display_matrix = [pdf_page getDisplayMatrix:0 top:0 width:width height:height rotate:FSRotation0];
 // Render page
 FSRenderer* renderer = [[FSRenderer alloc] initWithBitmap:bitmap is_rgb_order:NO];

 FSOutputPreview* output_preview = [[FSOutputPreview alloc] initWithPdf_doc:pdf_doc];
 NSString* simulation_icc_file_path = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"icc_profile/USWebCoatedSWOP.icc"];
 [output_preview setSimulationProfile:simulation_icc_file_path];
 [output_preview setShowType:FSOutputPreviewShowAll];
 NSArray<NSString *>* process_plates = [output_preview getPlates:FSOutputPreviewColorantTypeProcess];
 NSArray<NSString *>* spot_plates = [output_preview getPlates:FSOutputPreviewColorantTypeSpot];

 // Set check status of spot plate to be true, if there's any spot plate.
 for (int i = 0; i < [spot_plates count]; i++) {
 [output_preview setCheckStatus:[spot_plates objectAtIndex:i] to_check:true];
 }

 // Only set one process plate to be checked each time and generate the preview bitmap.
 for (int i = 0; i < [process_plates count]; i++) {
 if (0 != i)
 [output_preview setCheckStatus:[process_plates objectAtIndex:(i-1)] to_check:false];
 [output_preview setCheckStatus:[process_plates objectAtIndex:i] to_check:true];

 FSBitmap* preview_bitmap = [output_preview generatePreviewBitmap:pdf_page matrix:display_matrix renderer:renderer];

 FSImage* image = [FSImage new];
 [image addFrame:preview_bitmap];
 NSString* file_name = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"preview_result_ProcessPlate[%d]_true.bmp",i];
 [image saveAs:file_name];
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert jb2 files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert bmp to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.bmp";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_bmp.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert bmp to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.bmp";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_bmp_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert bmp to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.bmp";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_bmp_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert a PDF file to PDFA-1a version.

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to create a PDF document insert the text objects into the created PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddTextObject(FSPDFPage *page) {
 long position = [page getLastGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSTextObject *text_object = [FSTextObject create];

 text_object.fillColor = 0xFFFF7F00;

 // Prepare text state
 FSTextState *state = [[FSTextState alloc] init];
 state.font_size = 80.0f;
 FSFont *font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Simsun" styles:FSFontStylesSmallCap charset:FSFontCharsetGB2312 weight:0];
 state.font = font;
 state.textmode = FSTextStateModeFill;
 [text_object setTextState:page text_state:state is_italic:NO weight:750];

 // Set text.
 text_object.text = @"Foxit Software";
 long last_position = [page insertGraphicsObject:position graphics_object:text_object];

 FSRectF *rect = [text_object getRect];
 float offset_x = ([page getWidth] - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = [page getHeight] * 0.8f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 [text_object transform:[[FSMatrix2D alloc] initWithA1:1 b1:0 c1:0 d1:1 e1:offset_x f1:offset_y] need_transform_clippath:NO];

 // Generate content
 [page generateContent];

 //Show how to get the characters' information of text object.
 int text_object_charcount = [text_object getCharCount];

 for (int i = 0; i < text_object_charcount; i++) {
 //The character's position.
 FSPointF* char_pos = [text_object getCharPos:i];
 //The character's width.
 float width = [text_object getCharWidthByIndex:i];
 //The character's height.
 float height = [text_object getCharHeightByIndex:i];
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"graphics_objects.pdf";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 // Add a new PDF page and insert text objects.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 AddTextObject(page);

 output_file = @"graphics_objects_remove_text_objects.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert jpx files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert jpx to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jpx";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jpx.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert jpx to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jpx";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jpx_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert jpx to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jpx";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jpx_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

How to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of insert text type.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* rime = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(rime->tm_year + 1900) month:(rime->tm_mon + 1) day:(rime->tm_mday) hour:(rime->tm_hour) minute:(rime->tm_min) second:(rime->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

void createInsertTextStamp(FSPDFPage* page, FSRectFArray* rects, int color, NSString *csContents, NSString *csType, NSString *csObjType)
{
 FSRectF* rcStamp = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 int rectSize = [rects getSize];
 if (rectSize > 0)
 {
 FSRectF* item = [rects getAt:0];
 rcStamp.left = item.left;
 rcStamp.top = item.top - 4;
 rcStamp.right = rcStamp.left + 4;
 rcStamp.bottom = rcStamp.top - 8;
 }

 FSImage* pImage = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:[input_path stringByAppendingString:@"pdfcompare/insert_stamp.png"]];
 FSStamp* stamp = [[FSStamp alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotStamp rect:rcStamp]];

 [stamp setContent:csContents];
 [stamp setBorderColor:color];
 [stamp setSubject:csObjType];
 [stamp setTitle:csType];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [stamp setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [stamp setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [stamp setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 [stamp setImage:pImage frame_index:0 compress:0];

 [stamp resetAppearanceStream];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *base_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_base_file];
 errorCode = [base_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSPDFDoc *compared_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_compared_file];
 errorCode = [compared_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSComparison* comparison = [[FSComparison alloc] initWithBase_doc:base_doc compared_doc:compared_doc];
 FSCompareResults* result = [comparison doCompare:0 compared_page_index:0 compare_flags:FSComparisonCompareTypeText];
 int oldInfoSize = [result.base_doc_results getSize];
 int newInfoSize = [result.compared_doc_results getSize];
 FSPDFPage* page = [compared_doc getPage:0];
 FSPDFPage* page1 = [base_doc getPage:0];
 for (int i=0; i<oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 FSCompareResultInfo* item = [result.compared_doc_results getAt:i];
 FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultTypeInsertText)
 {
 NSString* res_string = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"\"%@\"", item.diff_contents];
 createInsertTextStamp(page1, item.rect_array, 0x0000ff, res_string, @"Compare : Insert", @"Text");
 }
 }
 FSPDFDoc* new_doc = [comparison generateComparedDoc:FSComparisonCompareTypeAll];
 [new_doc saveAs:@"generate_result.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into image form xObject.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AF_Catalog_Page_Annot.pdf"

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 2.jpg image.
 FSFileSpec *filespec_jpg = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_jpg.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_jpg.fileName = @"2.jpg";
 filespec_jpg.description = @"jpeg";
 [filespec_jpg embed:@"2.jpg"];
 filespec_jpg.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 2.jpg with form XObject.
 {
 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeFormXObject];
 FSFormXObject *form_x_object = [[page getGraphicsObject:position] getFormXObject];
 if (form_x_object != nil) {
 [associated_files associateFileWithFormXObject:form_x_object file_spec:filespec_jpg];

 FSPDFStream *stream = [form_x_object getStream];
 FSPDFDictionary *dictionary = [stream getDictionary];
 FSFileSpec *filespec_form_x_object = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:dictionary index:0];
 [filespec_form_x_object exportToFile:"form_x_object.jpg"];
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do full text search in PDF documents under a folder.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface MySearchCallback : NSObject<FSSearchCallback>
{

}
-(id)init;
@end
@implementation MySearchCallback
-(id)init {
	return self;
}

-(int)retrieveSearchResult:(NSString *)file_path page_index:(int)page_index match_result:(NSString *)match_result match_start_text_index:(int)match_start_text_index match_end_text_index:(int)match_end_text_index
{
	return 0;
}

@end

@interface PauseUtil : NSObject<FSPauseCallback>
@property int pause_count_limit_;
@property int pause_count_;
-(id)init;
-(id)initWithParam:(int)pause_limit_;
-(BOOL)needPauseNow;
@end
@implementation PauseUtil
-(id)init {
 _pause_count_ = 0;
	_pause_count_limit_ = 30;
	return self;
}

-(id)initWithParam:(int)pause_limit_{
 self = [super init];
 if(self){
	_pause_count_limit_ = pause_limit_;
	}
 return self;
}

- (BOOL)needPauseNow {
	if (_pause_count_ < _pause_count_limit_)
	{
 _pause_count_++;
 return true;
	}
	else
	{
 _pause_count_ = 0;
 return false;
	}
}
@end

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {
	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSFullTextSearch *fulltextsearch = [[FSFullTextSearch alloc]init];
 NSString *dbPath = @"search.db";
 [fulltextsearch setDataBasePath:dbPath];
 // Get document source information.
 FSDocumentsSource* source = [[FSDocumentsSource alloc]initWithDirectory:input_path];
 // Create a Pause callback object implemented by users to pause the updating process.
 PauseUtil* pause = [[PauseUtil alloc]initWithParam:30];
 // Start to update the index of PDF files which receive from the source.
 FSProgressive *progressive = [fulltextsearch startUpdateIndex:source pause:pause reupdate:NO];
 while ([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued) {
 ;
 }
 // Create a callback object which will be invoked when a matched one is found.
 MySearchCallback* searchCallback = [[MySearchCallback alloc]init];

 // Search the specified keyword from the indexed data source.
 [fulltextsearch searchOf:@"Foxit" rank_mode:FSFullTextSearchRankHitCountASC callback:searchCallback];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a screen annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 //Add a screen annotation.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:300 bottom1:150 right1:400 top1:200];
 FSScreen* screen = [[FSScreen alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotScreen rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [screen setFlags:4];
 NSString *image_path = [input_path stringByAppendingString:@"FoxitLogo.jpg"];
 FSImage* image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:image_path];
 [screen setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 [screen setBorderColor:0x0000FF];
 FSFloatArray* floatArray = [FSFloatArray new];
 FSBorderInfo* borderinfo = [[FSBorderInfo alloc] initWithWidth:2 style:FSBorderInfoSolid intensity:0 dash_phase:0 dashes:floatArray];
 [screen setBorderInfo:borderinfo];
 [screen setImage:image frame_index:0 compress:1];

 //Prepare rendition action.
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [page getDocument];
 FSRenditionAction* rendition_action = [[FSRenditionAction alloc] initWithAction:[FSAction create:doc action_type:FSActionTypeRendition]];
 [rendition_action setOperationType:FSRenditionActionOpTypeAssociate];
 [rendition_action setScreenAnnot:screen];

 //Prepare rendition.
 FSRendition* rendition = [[FSRendition alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc rendition_dict:nil];
 [rendition setRenditionName:@"screen for rendition"];
 [rendition setMediaClipName:@"ytb210-Mopa.mp4"];
 [rendition setPermission:FSRenditionMediaPermTempAccess];
 FSFileSpec* video_filespec = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 [video_filespec setFileName:@"ytb210-Mopa.mp4"];

 NSString *video_file_path = [input_path stringByAppendingString:@"ytb210-Mopa.mp4"];
 [video_filespec embed:video_file_path];
 [rendition setMediaClipFile:video_filespec];
 [rendition setMediaClipContentType:@"video/mp4"];

 [rendition_action insertRendition:rendition index:-1];

 [screen setAction:rendition_action];
 [screen resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a screen annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to redact some content in a PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSRedaction *redaction = [[FSRedaction alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Parse PDF page.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:false];
 FSTextPage *text_page = [[FSTextPage alloc] initWithPage:page flags:FSTextPageParseTextNormal];
 FSTextSearch *text_search = [[FSTextSearch alloc] initWithText_page:text_page];
 [text_search setPattern:@"PDF"];
 FSRectFArray *rect_array = [[FSRectFArray alloc] init];
 while ([text_search findNext]) {
 FSRectFArray *matchrects = [text_search getMatchRects];
 for (int z = 0; z < [matchrects getSize]; z++) {
 FSRectF *temp_rect = [matchrects getAt:z];
 [rect_array add:temp_rect];
 }
 }
 if ([rect_array getSize] > 0) {
 FSRedact *redact = [redaction markRedactAnnot:page rects:rect_array];
 [redact resetAppearanceStream];
 [doc saveAs:@"AboutFoxit_redected_default.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 // Set border color to green.
 [redact setBorderColor:0x00FF00];
 // Set fill color to blue.
 [redact setFillColor:0x0000FF];
 // Set rollover fill color to red.
 [redact setApplyFillColor:0xFF0000];
 [redact resetAppearanceStream];
 [doc saveAs:@"AboutFoxit_redected_setColor.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

 [redact setOpacity:0.5];
 [redact resetAppearanceStream];
 [doc saveAs:@"AboutFoxit_redected_setOpacity.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 if ([redaction apply]) {
 NSLog(@"Redact page (0) succeed.");
 } else {
 NSLog(@"Redact page (0) failed.");
 }
 }
 [doc saveAs:@"AboutFoxit_redected_apply.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to verify if a PDF file is PDFA-1a version.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface MyComplianceProgressCallback : NSObject<FSComplianceProgressCallback>
{
}
-(id)init;
@end

@implementation MyComplianceProgressCallback

-(id)init {
	return self;
}

-(void)updateCurrentStateData: (int)current_rate current_state_string: (NSString*)current_state_string {
	NSLog(@"Current rate: %d", current_rate);
}

@end

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 @try {
 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 NSString* compliance_resource_folder_path = @"";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for FSComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 NSString* compliance_engine_unlockcode = @"";

 if ([compliance_resource_folder_path length] < 1) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 errorCode = [FSComplianceEngine initialize:compliance_resource_folder_path compliance_engine_unlockcode:compliance_engine_unlockcode];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Verify original PDF file.
 MyComplianceProgressCallback* verify_progress_callback = [[MyComplianceProgressCallback alloc] init];
 FSResultInformation* verify_result_info = [pdfa_compliance verify:FSPDFAComplianceVersionPDFA1a src_pdf_path:input_file first_page_index:0 last_page_index:-1 progress_callback:verify_progress_callback];

 // Release compliance engine.
 [FSComplianceEngine destroy];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add fillsign to PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString *input_file = @"blank.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 FSFillSign *fillsign = [[FSFillSign alloc] initWithPage:page];

 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:0 y:0];

 FSFillSignObject *fillsignobject = [fillsign addObject:FSFillSignFillSignObjectTypeCrossMark point:point width:100 height:100 rotation:FSRotation0 ];
 [point set:100 y:100];
 fillsignobject = [fillsign addObject:FSFillSignFillSignObjectTypeCheckMark point:point width:50 height:100 rotation:FSRotation0];
 [point set:200 y:200];
 fillsignobject = [fillsign addObject:FSFillSignFillSignObjectTypeRoundRectangle point:point width:100 height:50 rotation:FSRotation0];
 [point set:300 y:300];
 fillsignobject = [fillsign addObject:FSFillSignFillSignObjectTypeLine point:point width:100 height:50 rotation:FSRotation0];
 [point set:400 y:400];
 fillsignobject = [fillsign addObject:FSFillSignFillSignObjectTypeDot point:point width:100 height:100 rotation:FSRotation0];

 FSTextState *textState = [[FSTextState alloc] init];
 FSFont* font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelvetica];
 textState.font = font;
 textState.font_size = 20;
 [point set:500 y:0];
 textState.origin_position = point;
 textState.charspace = 1.0f;

 FSTextFillSignObjectData *textdata = [[FSTextFillSignObjectData alloc] initWithText_state:textState text:@"666777888"];
 FSTextFillSignObjectDataArray *textdataarray =[[FSTextFillSignObjectDataArray alloc] init];
 [textdataarray add:textdata ];
 [point set:400 y:100];
 FSFillSignObject *text = [fillsign addTextObject:textdataarray point:point width:200 height:200 rotation:FSRotation0 is_comb_field_mode:false];
 [text generateContent];

 [point set:300 y:100];
 fillsignobject = [fillsign addObject:FSFillSignFillSignObjectTypeSignature point:point width:100 height:100 rotation:FSRotation0 ];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [[FSBitmap alloc] initWithWidth:100 height:100 format:FSBitmapDIBArgb buffer:nil pitch:0];
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFF0000 rect:nil];
 FSSignatureFillSignObject *signature = [[FSSignatureFillSignObject alloc] initWithFillsign_object:fillsignobject];
 [signature setBitmap:bitmap];
 [fillsignobject generateContent];
 [page generateContent];

 NSString *output_file = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"new_fillsign.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }

 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to swap the X and Y axis, and then vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap *bitmap, NSString *file_path) {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];
 [image saveAs:file_path];
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"Foxit.bmp";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];
 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Swap the X and Y axis, and then vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 FSBitmap *swapxy_bitmap = [bitmap swapXY:YES is_flip_vert:YES clip_rect:nil];
 output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@", @"swap_xy_flip_horz_vert_Foxit.bmp"];
 saveBitmap(swapxy_bitmap, output_file);

 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add attached files to PDF files

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";
NSString *content = @"";

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

// The results are displayed in the txt file.
void textOutput(NSString *str) {
 content = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@\n", content, str];
 NSLog(@"%@", content);
}

NSString *DateTimeToString(const FSDateTime *datetime) {
 NSString *s_datetime = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%d/%d/%d-%d:%d:%d %@%d:%d", datetime.year, datetime.month, datetime.day, datetime.hour, datetime.minute, datetime.second, datetime.utc_hour_offset > 0 ? @"+" : @"-", datetime.utc_hour_offset, datetime.utc_minute_offset];
 return s_datetime;
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"attachment.pdf";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }

 {
 NSString *text_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 FSAttachments *attachment = [[FSAttachments alloc] initWithDoc:doc nametree:[[FSPDFNameTree alloc] init]];
 // Add new attachment to PDF document.
 [attachment addFromFilePath:@"OriginalAttachmentsInfo" file_path:text_path];
 NSString *newPdf = @"attachment_add.pdf", output_directory;
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 NSLog(@"Add a new attachment to PDF document.");
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to tag a PDF document.

#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface TaggedPDFCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSTaggedPDFCallback>
-(id)init;
@end

@implementation TaggedPDFCallbackImpl
-(id)init {
 return self;
}

-(void)report:(FSTaggedPDFCallbackReportCategory)category confidence:(FSTaggedPDFCallbackReportConfidence)confidence page_index:(int)page_index rect:(FSRectF*)rect {

}
@end
int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString *inputFile = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"AboutFoxit.pdf"];

 // tag a PDF document
 {
 NSString *outputFile= @"TaggedPdf_StartAutoTagged.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:inputFile];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSTaggedPDF* taggedpdf = [[FSTaggedPDF alloc] initWithDoc:doc];
 FSProgressive* progressive = [taggedpdf startTagDocument:nil];
 while([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued){
 ;
 }
 [doc saveAs:outputFile save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }

 // tag a PDF document with callback
 {
 NSString *outputFile= @"TaggedPdf_StartAutoTagged_SetCallback.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:inputFile];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSTaggedPDF* taggedpdf = [[FSTaggedPDF alloc] initWithDoc:doc];
 TaggedPDFCallbackImpl* callback = [[TaggedPDFCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [taggedpdf setCallback:callback];
 FSProgressive* progressive = [taggedpdf startTagDocument:nil];
 while([progressive resume] == FSProgressiveToBeContinued){
 ;
 }
 [doc saveAs:outputFile save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}
