how to use Foxit PDF SDK to remove watermarks in PDF files.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";

 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 if ([page hasWatermark])
 {
 [page removeAllWatermarks];
 }
 }

 save_pdf_name = @"watermark_remove.pdf";
 save_pdf_path = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:save_pdf_name];

 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];

 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert jpg files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert jpg to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jpg";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jpg.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert jpg to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jpg";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jpg_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert jpg to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.jpg";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_jpg_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a freetext annotation with richtext as type writer.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation with richtext, as type writer.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:10 bottom1:50 right1:200 top1:100];
 FSFreeText* freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [freetext setFlags:4];
 // Set default appearance
 unsigned int da_flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 FSFont* da_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelvetica];
 FSDefaultAppearance* default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:da_flags font:da_font text_size:12.0 text_color:0x000000];
 // Set default appearance for form.
 [freetext setDefaultAppearance:default_ap];
 [freetext setIntent:@"FreeTextTypewriter"];
 [freetext setContent:@"A typewriter annotation"];
 [freetext setSubject:@"FreeTextTypewriter"];
 [freetext setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [freetext setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 FSRichTextStyle* richtext_style = [[FSRichTextStyle alloc] init];
 FSFont* rcstyle_font_1 = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Times New Roman" styles:0 charset:FSFontCharsetANSI weight:0];
 [richtext_style setFont:rcstyle_font_1];
 [richtext_style setText_color:0xFF0000];
 [richtext_style setText_size:10];
 [freetext addRichText:@"Typewriter annotation " style:richtext_style];

 [richtext_style setText_color:0x00FF00];
 [richtext_style setIs_underline:YES];
 [freetext addRichText:@"1-underline " style:richtext_style];

 [richtext_style setIs_underline:NO];
 [richtext_style setText_color:0x0000FF];
 [richtext_style setIs_strikethrough:YES];
 FSFont* rcstyle_font_2 = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Calibri" styles:0 charset:FSFontCharsetANSI weight:0];
 [richtext_style setFont:rcstyle_font_2];
 int rc_count = [freetext getRichTextCount];
 [freetext insertRichText:(rc_count-1) content:@"2_strikethrough " style:richtext_style];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a typewriter freetext annotation with richtext.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to do PDF page organization such as moving.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

bool MovePages()
{
	NSString *input_file = @"page_organization_123.pdf";
	NSString *input_file1 = @"page_organization_abc.pdf";
	// Move page
	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}
	int count = [doc getPageCount];
	FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
	[doc movePageTo:page dest_index:[doc getPageCount] - 1];
	NSString *output_file1 = @"move_first_page_to_last.pdf";
	[doc saveAs:output_file1 save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];

	doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file1];
	code = [doc load:nil];
	if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 return false;
	}
	FSRange *page_set = [[FSRange alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count / 2; i++)
 [page_set addSingle:2 * i];
	[doc movePagesTo:page_set dest_index:[doc getPageCount] - 1];
	NSString *output_file = @"move_pages.pdf";
	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
	NSLog(@"Move pages.");
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 if (!MovePages()) {
 return 1;
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;

 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];

 return -1;

 //This flag is used for printing annotations.

 NSLog(@"Add a circle annotation.");
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to reflow PDF pages

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotations.pdf";

 // Load PDF document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 {
 // Flatten PDF
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = [doc getPageCount];
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for(int i=0;i<pageCount;i++){
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 [page flatten:YES options:FSPDFPageFlattenAll];
 }

 NSString* flatten_all = @"annotations_flatten_all.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:flatten_all save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 {
 // Flatten PDF with no annotation
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = [doc getPageCount];
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for(int i=0;i<pageCount;i++){
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 [page flatten:YES options:FSPDFPageFlattenNoAnnot];
 }

 NSString* flatten_all = @"annotations_flatten_noannot.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:flatten_all save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 {
 // Flatten PDF with no form control
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = [doc getPageCount];
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for(int i=0;i<pageCount;i++){
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 [page flatten:YES options:FSPDFPageFlattenNoFormControl];
 }
 NSString* flatten_all = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@",output_directory, @"annotations_flatten_noformcontrol.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:flatten_all save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 {
 // Flatten PDF with no form control and no annotation -- equals to nothing to be flattened.
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = [doc getPageCount];
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for(int i=0;i<pageCount;i++){
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];
 [page flatten:YES options:FSPDFPageFlattenNoAnnot|FSPDFPageFlattenNoFormControl];
 }

 NSString* flatten_all = @"annotations_flatten_noannotnoform.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:flatten_all save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
	}

}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to enumerate and modify bookmarks in PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *input_path = @"../input_files/";
NSString *output_path = @"../output_files/";

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

void ShowBookmarkInfo(FSBookmark *bookmark, NSMutableString *info, int depth) {
	if (depth > 32)
 return;
	if ([bookmark isEmpty]) {
 return;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
 [info appendString:@"\t"];
	}
	[info appendString:[bookmark getTitle] ?: @""];
	[info appendString:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"\tcolor: 0x%x\n", [bookmark getColor]]];
	ShowBookmarkInfo([bookmark getFirstChild], info, depth + 1);
	ShowBookmarkInfo([bookmark getNextSibling], info, depth);
}

void ShowBookmarksInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc, NSString *info_path) {
	NSMutableString *info = [NSMutableString new];
	FSBookmark *root = [doc getRootBookmark];
	if (![root isEmpty]) {
 ShowBookmarkInfo(root, info, 0);
	} else {
 [info appendString:@"No bookmark information!\n"];
	}
	[[info dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] writeToFile:info_path atomically:YES];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 NSString *output_file = @"bookmark_change.pdf";

 @try {

 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode code = [doc load:nil];
 if (code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %d", input_file, (int)code);
 return 1;
 }

 FSBookmark *root = [doc getRootBookmark];
 if ([root isEmpty]) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Get first bookmark and change properties.
 FSBookmark *first_bookmark = [root getFirstChild];
 [first_bookmark setStyle:FSBookmarkStyleItalic];
 [first_bookmark setColor:0xFF0000];
 [first_bookmark setTitle:@"Change bookmark title, style, and color"];

 // Remove next sibling bookmark
 if (![[first_bookmark getNextSibling] isEmpty]) {
 [doc removeBookmark:[first_bookmark getNextSibling]];
 }
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get and extract attached files from PDF files

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void textOutput(NSString *str) {
 NSString *content = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@\n", str];
 NSLog(@"%@", content);
}

NSString *DateTimeToString(const FSDateTime *datetime) {
 NSString *s_datetime = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%d/%d/%d-%d:%d:%d %@%d:%d", datetime.year, datetime.month, datetime.day, datetime.hour, datetime.minute, datetime.second, datetime.utc_hour_offset > 0 ? @"+" : @"-", datetime.utc_hour_offset, datetime.utc_minute_offset];
 return s_datetime;
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"attachment.pdf";

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return 1;
 }
 {
 // Get information of attachments.
 FSAttachments *attachment = [[FSAttachments alloc] initWithDoc:doc nametree:[[FSPDFNameTree alloc] init]];
 int count = [attachment getCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 NSString *key = [attachment getKey:i];
 textOutput([[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"Key:\t\t%@\r", key]);

 FSFileSpec *file_spec = [attachment getEmbeddedFile:key];
 if (![file_spec isEmpty]) {
 NSString *name = [file_spec getFileName];
 textOutput([[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"Name:\t\t%@\r", name]);
 textOutput([[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"Size:\t\t%lld\r", [file_spec getFileSize]]);
 textOutput([[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"Is embedded:\t%@\r", [file_spec isEmbedded] ? @"true" : @"false"]);
 textOutput([[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"Creation time:\t%@\r", DateTimeToString([file_spec getCreationDateTime])]);
 textOutput([[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"Modified time:\t%@\r", DateTimeToString([file_spec getModifiedDateTime])]);
 textOutput(@"\r");

 if ([file_spec isEmbedded]) {
 NSString *exFilePath = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@", output_directory, name];
 bool bExportStatus = [file_spec exportToFile:exFilePath];
 NSLog(@"%@ ExportToFile %@", name, bExportStatus ? @"successful" : @"failed");
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add, sign in PDF document by default and then verify signature in PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <netdb.h>

#include <string>

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

// Some base type declarations
typedef std::string String;

void AdobePPKLiteSignature(FSPDFDoc *pdf_doc) {
 NSString *filter = @"Adobe.PPKLite";
 NSString *sub_filter = @"adbe.pkcs7.detached";

 FSPDFPage *pdf_page = [pdf_doc getPage:0];
 // Add a new signature to first page.
 FSSignature *new_signature = AddSiganture(pdf_page, sub_filter);
 // Set filter and subfilter for the new signature.
 [new_signature setFilter:filter];
 [new_signature setSubFilter:sub_filter];
 bool is_signed = [new_signature isSigned];
 unsigned int sig_state = [new_signature getState];

 // Sign the new signature.
 NSString *signed_pdf_path = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"signed_newsignature_default_handler.pdf"];
 NSString *cert_file_path = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"foxit_all.pfx"];
 NSString *cert_file_password = @"123456";
 // Cert file path will be passed back to application through callback function FSSignatureCallback::Sign().
 // In this demo, the cert file path will be used for signing in callback function FSSignatureCallback::Sign().
 [new_signature startSign:cert_file_path cert_password:cert_file_password digest_algorithm:FSSignatureDigestSHA1 save_path:signed_pdf_path client_data:nil pause:nil];
 is_signed = [new_signature isSigned];
 sig_state = [new_signature getState];

 // Open the signed document and verify the newly added signature (which is the last one).
 FSPDFDoc *signed_pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:signed_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [signed_pdf_doc load:nil];
 if (FSErrSuccess != error_code) {
 return;
 }
 // Get the last signature which is just added and signed.
 int sig_count = [signed_pdf_doc getSignatureCount];
 FSSignature *signed_signature = [signed_pdf_doc getSignature:sig_count - 1];
 // Verify the intergrity of signature.
 [signed_signature startVerify:nil pause:nil];
 is_signed = [signed_signature isSigned];
 sig_state = [signed_signature getState];
}

void CheckSignatureInfo(FSPDFDoc *pdf_doc) {
	int sig_count = [pdf_doc getSignatureCount];
	if (sig_count<1) {
 return;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < sig_count; i++) {
 FSSignature *signature = [pdf_doc getSignature:i];
 if ([signature isEmpty]) continue;
 bool is_signed = [signature isSigned];
 unsigned int sig_state = [signature getState];

 FSWidget *widget_annot = [[signature getControl:0] getWidget];

 NSString *filter = [signature getFilter];
 NSString *sub_filter = [signature getSubFilter];
 if (is_signed){
 FSDateTime *sign_time = [signature getSignTime];
 NSString *time_str = DateTimeToString(sign_time);
 }
 NSString* signer = [signature getKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameSigner];
 NSString* location = [signature getKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameLocation];
 NSString* reason = [signature getKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameReason];
 NSString* contact_info = [signature getKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameContactInfo];
 NSString* DN = [signature getKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameDN];
 NSString* text = [signature getKeyValue:FSSignatureKeyNameText];
	}
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 NSString *input_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 [pdf_doc startLoad:nil is_cache_stream:NO pause:nil];

 // Add new signature, sign it and verify it with filter "Adobe.PPKLite" and different subfilter.
 AdobePPKLiteSignature(pdf_doc);
 CheckSignatureInfo(pdf_doc);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }

 return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to operate PDF objects directly.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

// This function is to do some operation to PDF object.
void ObjectOperation(FSPDFDoc *document) {\
 // Create boolean object.
 FSPDFObject *boolean_object = [FSPDFObject createFromBoolean:YES];
 unsigned int boolean_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:boolean_object];
 bool boolean_object_value = [boolean_object getBoolean];

 // Create float object.
 FSPDFObject *float_object = [FSPDFObject createFromFloat:0.1f];
 unsigned int float_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:float_object];
 float float_object_value = [float_object getFloat];

 // Create integer object.
 FSPDFObject *integer_object = [FSPDFObject createFromInteger:1];
 unsigned int integer_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:integer_object];
 int integer_object_value = [integer_object getInteger];

 // Create string object.
 FSPDFObject *string_object = [FSPDFObject createFromString:@"foxit"];
 unsigned int string_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:string_object];
 NSString *string_object_value = [string_object getWideString];

 // Create name object.
 FSPDFObject *name_object = [FSPDFObject createFromName:@"sdk"];
 unsigned int name_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:name_object];
 NSString *name_object_value = [name_object getName];

 // Create datetime object.
 FSDateTime *date_time = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:27 hour:19 minute:36 second:6 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 FSPDFObject *datetime_object = [FSPDFObject createFromDateTime:date_time];
 unsigned int datetime_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:datetime_object];
 NSString *datetime_object_value = [datetime_object getWideString];

 FSPDFArray *array = [FSPDFArray create];
 FSPDFObject *boolean_object_reference = [FSPDFObject createReference:document object_number:boolean_object_number];
 unsigned int boolean_object_reference_number = [boolean_object_reference getObjNum];
 FSPDFObject *float_object_reference = [FSPDFObject createReference:document object_number:float_object_number];
 FSPDFObject *integer_object_reference = [FSPDFObject createReference:document object_number:integer_object_number];
 FSPDFObject *integer_object_direct = [integer_object_reference getDirectObject];
 FSPDFObject *string_object_reference = [FSPDFObject createReference:document object_number:string_object_number];
 FSPDFObject *name_object_reference = [FSPDFObject createReference:document object_number:string_object_number];
 FSPDFObject *datetime_object_reference = [FSPDFObject createReference:document object_number:string_object_number];

 [array addElement:boolean_object_reference];
 [array addElement:float_object_reference];
 [array addElement:integer_object_reference];
 [array addElement:string_object_reference];
 [array addElement:name_object_reference];
 [array addElement:datetime_object_reference];
 [array addElement:[boolean_object cloneObject]];

 unsigned int array_object_number = [document addIndirectObject:array];
}

// This function is to remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
void RemoveCatalogKey(FSPDFDoc *document) {
 if ([document isEmpty]) {
 return;
 }
 FSPDFDictionary *catalog = [document getCatalog];
 if (catalog == NULL)
 return;

 NSArray *key_strings = [[NSArray alloc] initWithObjects:@"Type", @"Boolean", @"Name", @"String", @"Array", @"Dict", nil];
 for (int i = 0; i < [key_strings count]; i++) {
 if ([catalog hasKey:key_strings[i]]) {
 [catalog removeAt:key_strings[i]];
 }
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 [doc startLoad:@"" is_cache_stream:NO pause:nil];

 // Do some operation about PDF object.
 ObjectOperation(doc);
 NSString *save_pdf_patth = @"pdfobjects_addnewobjects.pdf";
 [doc startSaveAs:save_pdf_patth save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal pause:nil];

 // To remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 RemoveCatalogKey(doc);
 save_pdf_patth = @"pdfobjects_removekeyfromcatalog.pdf";
 [doc startSaveAs:save_pdf_patth save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal pause:nil];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a highlight annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add highlight annotation.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:10 bottom1:450 right1:100 top1:550];
 FSHighlight* highlight = [[FSHighlight alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotHighlight rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [highlight setFlags:4];
 [highlight setContent:@"Highlight"];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:10 y:500];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:90 y:500];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:10 y:480];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:90 y:480];
 quad_points.fourth = point;
 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];
 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 [highlight setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];
 [highlight setSubject:@"Highlight"];
 [highlight setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [highlight setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [highlight setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [highlight setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [highlight resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a highlight annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a strikeout annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add strikeout annotation.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:300 bottom1:450 right1:400 top1:550];
 FSStrikeOut* strikeout = [[FSStrikeOut alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotStrikeOut rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [strikeout setFlags:4];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:310 y:500];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:390 y:500];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:310 y:480];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:390 y:480];
 quad_points.fourth = point;
 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];
 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 [strikeout setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];
 [strikeout setSubject:@"StrikeOut"];
 [strikeout setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [strikeout setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [strikeout setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [strikeout setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [strikeout resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a strikeout annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into page dictionary.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 NSString *input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FSFileSpec *filespec_txt = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_txt.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_txt.fileName = @"1.txt";
 FSDateTime *dateTime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:15 hour:17 minute:20 second:20 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 filespec_txt.description = @"text";
 [filespec_txt embed:@"1.txt"];
 filespec_txt.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 // Associate 1.txt with page dictionary.

 [associated_files associateFileWithPDFPage:page file_spec:filespec_txt];

 FSFileSpec *filespec_page = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:[page getDict] index:0];
 [filespec_page exportToFile:@"page.txt"];

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into marked content.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 NSString* input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld\n", input_file, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 2.jpg image.
 FSFileSpec *filespec_jpg = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_jpg.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_jpg.fileName = @"2.jpg";
 filespec_jpg.description = @"jpeg";
 [filespec_jpg embed:[input_path stringByAppendingString:@"2.jpg"]];
 filespec_jpg.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 2.jpg with marked content.
 {
 FSPDFDictionary *page_dict = [page getDict];
 FSPDFDictionary *resource_dict = (FSPDFDictionary *) [page_dict getElement:@"Resources"];
 if (resource_dict == nil)
 return 1;

 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSGraphicsObject *text_object = [page getGraphicsObject:position];
 if (text_object != nil) {
 FSMarkedContent *markcontent = [text_object getMarkedContent];
 if (markcontent == nil)
 return 1;
 if ([markcontent getItemCount] == 0)
 [markcontent addItem:@"Associated" property_dict:NULL];
 [associated_files associateFileWithGraphicsObject:text_object mark_content_item_index:0 current_resource:resource_dict property_name:@"textobject" file_spec:filespec_jpg];
 [page generateContent];

 }
 }
 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to create or open a portfolio PDF file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

BOOL CreatPortfolioPDF(NSString* saved_portfolio_pdf_path) {
 // Create a new blank portfolio PDF.
 FSPortfolio* new_portfolio = [FSPortfolio createPortfolio];
 if (YES == [new_portfolio isEmpty]) {
 return NO;
 }

 // Get the root node.
 FSPortfolioNode* root_node = [new_portfolio getRootNode];
 if (YES == [root_node isEmpty]) {
 return NO;
 }
 // The root node should be a folder node, so transfer to use FSPortfolioFolderNode.
 FSPortfolioFolderNode* root_folder = [[FSPortfolioFolderNode alloc] initWithOther:root_node];

 // Pre-load the PDF file which is to be added to new sub folder in portfolio PDF.
 // ATTENTION: please keep the PDF document object valid until portfolio PDF is saved or ends its life-cycle.
 NSString* input_pdf_file_path = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* pdf_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_file_path];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [pdf_doc load:nil];
 if (error_code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"[FAILED] Fail to load PDF file %@. Error: %ld", input_pdf_file_path, error_code);
 }

 // Add a sub folder to root folder node.
 FSPortfolioFolderNode* new_sub_foldernode = [root_folder addSubFolder:@"Sub Folder-1"];
 if (YES == [new_sub_foldernode isEmpty]) {
 NSLog(@"[FAILED] Fail to add sub folder.\n");
 } else {
 [new_sub_foldernode setDescription:@"This is a sub folder added to portfolio PDF file."];

 if (NO == [pdf_doc isEmpty]) {
 // Add a valid PDF document object to current folder node.
 // ATTENTION: please keep the PDF document object valid until portfolio PDF is saved or ends its life-cycle.
 FSPortfolioFileNode* new_filenode = [new_sub_foldernode addPDFDoc:pdf_doc file_name:input_pdf_filename];
 if (YES == [new_filenode isEmpty]) {
 NSLog(@"[FAILED] Fail to add PDF file %@.\n", input_pdf_file_path);
 } else {
 FSFileSpec* file_spec = [new_filenode getFileSpec];
 [file_spec setDescription:@"This is a common PDF file added to portfolio PDF file"];
 }
 }
 }

 // Add a non-PDF file to root folder node.
 NSString* input_file_path = [input_path stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"FoxitLogo.jpg"];
 FSPortfolioFileNode* new_sub_filenode = [root_folder addFile:input_file_path];
 if (YES == [new_sub_filenode isEmpty]) {
 NSLog(@"[FAILED] Fail to add file %@.\n", input_file_path);
 } else {
 FSFileSpec* file_spec = [new_sub_filenode getFileSpec];
 [file_spec setDescription:@"This is a non-PDF file added to portfolio PDF file."];
 }

 // User can update schema field and other properties by class Portfolio, if necessary.

 // Save the new portfolio PDF file.
 FSPDFDoc*portfolio_pdf_doc = [new_portfolio getPortfolioPDFDoc];
 if (YES == [portfolio_pdf_doc isEmpty]) {
 NSLog(@"[FAILED] Fail to get portfolio PDF document object.\n");
 return NO;
 } else {
 return [portfolio_pdf_doc saveAs:saved_portfolio_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* saved_portfolio_pdf_path = [output_directory stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"new_portfolio.pdf"];
 // Create a new portfolio PDF file
 CreatPortfolioPDF(saved_portfolio_pdf_path);
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
	}

	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add table to PDF document.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

FSRichTextStyle *GetTableTextStyle(int index){
 FSRichTextStyle* style = [[FSRichTextStyle alloc] init];
 FSFont* d_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelvetica];
 [style setFont:d_font];
 [style setText_size:10];
 [style setText_alignment:FSAlignmentLeft];
 [style setText_color:0x000000];
 [style setIs_bold:NO];
 [style setIs_italic:NO];
 [style setIs_underline:NO];
 [style setIs_strikethrough:NO];
 [style setMark_style:FSRichTextStyleCornerMarkNone];

 switch (index) {
 case 1:
 [style setText_alignment:FSAlignmentCenter];
 break;
 case 2: {
 [style setText_alignment:FSAlignmentRight];
 [style setText_color:0x00FF00];
 break;
 }
 default:
 break;
 }
 return style;
}

NSString *GetTableCellText(int index) {
 switch (index) {
 case 0:
 return @"Reference style";
 case 1 :
 return @"Alignment center";
 case 2:
 return @"Green text color and alignment right";
 default:
 return @" ";
 }
}

void AddElectronicTable(FSPDFPage *page){
 {
 // Add a spreadsheet with 4 rows and 3 columns
 int index = 0;
 FSTableCellDataArray *cell_array = [[FSTableCellDataArray alloc] init];
 for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
 FSTableCellDataColArray *col_array = [[FSTableCellDataColArray alloc] init];
 for (int col = 0; col < 3; col++) {
 FSRichTextStyle *style = GetTableTextStyle(index);
 NSString *cell_text = GetTableCellText(index);
 FSImage *cell_image = [[FSImage alloc] init];
 FSRectF* rect = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 FSTableCellData *cell_data = [[FSTableCellData alloc] initWithCell_text_style:style cell_text:cell_text cell_image:cell_image cell_margin:rect];
 [col_array add:cell_data];
 index = index + 1;
 }
 [cell_array add:col_array];
 }

 float width = [page getWidth];
 float height = [page getHeight];
 float right = width - 100;
 float top = height - 100;
 FSRectF* rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100 bottom1:550 right1:right top1:top];
 FSTableBorderInfo *outside_border_left = [[FSTableBorderInfo alloc] init];
 outside_border_left.line_width = 1;
 FSTableBorderInfo *outside_border_right = [[FSTableBorderInfo alloc] init];
 outside_border_right.line_width = 1;
 FSTableBorderInfo *outside_border_top = [[FSTableBorderInfo alloc] init];
 outside_border_top.line_width = 1;
 FSTableBorderInfo *outside_border_bottom = [[FSTableBorderInfo alloc] init];
 outside_border_bottom.line_width = 1;
 FSTableBorderInfo *inside_border_col_info = [[FSTableBorderInfo alloc] init];
 inside_border_col_info.line_width = 1;
 FSTableBorderInfo *inside_border_row_info = [[FSTableBorderInfo alloc] init];
 inside_border_row_info.line_width = 1;
 FSTableCellIndexArray* merge_cells = [[FSTableCellIndexArray alloc] init];
 FSFloatArray* row_height_array = [[FSFloatArray alloc] init];
 FSFloatArray* col_width_array = [[FSFloatArray alloc] init];
 FSTableData* data = [[FSTableData alloc] initWithRect:rect row_count:4 col_count:3 outside_border_left:outside_border_left outside_border_right:outside_border_right outside_border_top:outside_border_top outside_border_bottom:outside_border_bottom inside_border_row:inside_border_col_info inside_border_col:inside_border_row_info merge_cells:merge_cells row_height_array:row_height_array col_width_array:col_width_array];

 [FSTableGenerator addTableToPage:page data:data cell_array:cell_array];
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 AddElectronicTable(page);

 NSString *output_file = @"electronictable_result.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to convert png files to PDF files.Here are three methods introduced.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

@interface FSFileReader : NSObject<FSFileReaderCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* file_;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
//- (id)initWithSourceFilePath:(NSString *)path;
@end

@implementation FSFileReader

-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.file_ = fopen(mfilePath, "rb");
 if (!self.file_)
 return NO;
 return TRUE;
 }
-(unsigned long long)getSize{
 if (!self.file_) return NO;
 fseek(self.file_, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.file_);
 }

-(NSData*)readBlock:(unsigned long long)offset size:(unsigned long long)size {

	NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
	[fileHandle seekToFileOffset:offset];
	NSData *data = [fileHandle readDataOfLength:size];
	return data;
}
@end

@interface FSFileWriterCallbackImpl : NSObject<FSFileWriterCallback>
@property (nonatomic) FILE* mfile;
@property (nonatomic, strong) NSString* filePath;
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath;
@end

@implementation FSFileWriterCallbackImpl
-(BOOL)LoadFile:(NSString *)filePath
{
 self.filePath = filePath;
 const char* mfilePath = [filePath cStringUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
 self.mfile = fopen(mfilePath, "wb");
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;
 return TRUE;
}

-(unsigned long long)getSize {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 fseek(self.mfile, 0, SEEK_END);
 return (uint32)ftell(self.mfile);
}

-(BOOL)writeBlock:(NSData*)data offset:(unsigned long long)offset {
 if (!self.mfile) return NO;

 NSFileHandle *fileHandle = [NSFileHandle fileHandleForUpdatingAtPath:self.filePath];
 [fileHandle seekToEndOfFile];
 [fileHandle writeData:data];
 [fileHandle closeFile];

 return YES;
}

-(BOOL)flush {
 return YES;
}
@end

void Image2PDF(NSString *input_file, NSString *output_file) {
	FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
	int count = 1;
	if ([image getType] != FSImageJBIG2) {
 count = [image getFrameCount];
	}

	FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
	for (int i = 0; i < count; i ++) {
 float w = [image getWidth];
 float h = [image getHeight];
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPage:i width:w height:h];
 FSPointF *ptZero = [[FSPointF alloc] init];
 ptZero.x = 0;
 ptZero.y = 0;
 [page addImage:image frame_index:i position:ptZero width:w height:h auto_generate_content:YES];
	}

	[doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 // Convert png to pdf by using addImage with page.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.png";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_png.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file,output_file);

 // Convert png to pdf by path with convert api
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.png";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_png_frompath.pdf";
 [FSConvert fromImage:input_file saved_pdf_path:output_file];

 // Convert png to pdf by stream with convert api.
 NSString *input_file = @"watermark.png";
 NSString *output_file = @"watermark_png_stream.pdf";
 FSFileReader *file_reader = [[FSFileReader alloc] init];
 [file_reader LoadFile:input_file];
 FSFileWriterCallbackImpl *filewriter = [[FSFileWriterCallbackImpl alloc] init];
 [filewriter LoadFile:output_file];
 [FSConvert fromImageWithStreamCallback:file_reader saved_pdf_filestream:filewriter];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return -1;
 }
 }
	return 0;
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a square annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add square annotation
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:200 bottom1:650 right1:300 top1:750];
 FSSquare* square = [[FSSquare alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotSquare rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [square setFlags:4];
 [square setFillColor:0x00FF00];
 FSRectF* inner_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:220 bottom1:660 right1:260 top1:740];
 [square setInnerRect:inner_rect];
 [square setSubject:@"Square"];
 [square setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [square setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [square setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [square setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [square resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a square annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

how to use Foxit PDF SDK to add push button form field.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddPushButtonForm(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {

 // Add push button field.
 FSControl *btn_submit = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Push Button Submit" field_type:FSFieldTypePushButton rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50 bottom1:750 right1:150 top1:780]];

 // Set default appearance
 FSDefaultAppearance *default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize font:[[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelveticaB] text_size:12.0f text_color:0x000000];
 [form setDefaultAppearance:default_ap];

 // Set push button appearance.
 FSWidget *widget = [btn_submit getWidget];
 widget.highlightingMode = FSAnnotHighlightingPush;
 widget.mKBorderColor = 0xFF0000;
 widget.mKBackgroundColor = 0xF0F0F0;
 widget.mKNormalCaption = @"Submit";
 [widget resetAppearanceStream];

 // Set submit form action.
 FSSubmitFormAction *submit_action = [[FSSubmitFormAction alloc] initWithAction:[FSAction create:[form getDocument] action_type:FSActionTypeSubmitForm]];
 int count = [form getFieldCount:@""];
 NSArray *name_array = [[NSArray alloc] init];
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 name_array = [name_array arrayByAddingObject:[[form getField:i filter:@""] getName]];
 }
 submit_action.fieldNames = name_array;
 submit_action.uRL = @"http://www.foxitsoftware.com";
 widget.action = submit_action;
 }

}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Create a blank new page and add push button form field into it.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 AddPushButtonForm(page, form);
 NSString *newPdf = @"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

void AddInteractiveForms(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Add text field with flag comb
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Text Field3" field_type:FSFieldTypeTextField rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50.0 bottom1:570 right1:100 top1:590]];
 FSField *field = [control getField];
 field.flags = FSFieldFlagTextComb;
 field.value = @"94538";
 field.maxLength = 5;
 // Update text field's appearance.
 [[control getWidget] resetAppearanceStream];
 }
}

 AddInteractiveForms(page, form);

 NSString *newPdf = @"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add text form field.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

void AddTextFieldForm(FSPDFPage *page, FSForm *form) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Add text field
 FSControl *control = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Text Field0" field_type:FSFieldTypeTextField rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:50.0 bottom1:600 right1:90 top1:640]];
 [control getField].value = @"3";
 // Update text field's appearance.
 [[control getWidget] resetAppearanceStream];
 FSControl *control1 = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Text Field1" field_type:FSFieldTypeTextField rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100 bottom1:600 right1:140 top1:640]];
 [control1 getField].value = @"23";
 // Update text field's appearance.
 [[control1 getWidget] resetAppearanceStream];

 FSControl *control2 = [form addControl:page field_name:@"Text Field2" field_type:FSFieldTypeTextField rect:[[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:150 bottom1:600 right1:190 top1:640]];
 FSJavaScriptAction *javascipt_action = [[FSJavaScriptAction alloc] initWithAction:[FSAction create:[form getDocument] action_type:FSActionTypeJavaScript]];
 javascipt_action.script = @"AFSimple_Calculate(\"SUM\", new Array (\"Text Field0\", \"Text Field1\"));";
 FSField *field2 = [control2 getField];
 FSAdditionalAction *additional_act = [[FSAdditionalAction alloc] initWithField:field2];
 [additional_act setAction:FSAdditionalActionTriggerFieldRecalculateValue action:javascipt_action];
 [control2 getField].value = @"333333";
 // Update text field's appearance.
 [[control2 getWidget] resetAppearanceStream];
 }
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] init];
 FSForm *form = [[FSForm alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 // Create a blank new page and add text form field into it.
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc insertPageWithType:0 size:FSPDFPageSizeLetter];
 AddTextFieldForm(page, form);
 NSString *newPdf = :@"form.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:newPdf save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a freetext annotation with richtext as text box

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation with richtext, as text box.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:450 bottom1:50 right1:550 top1:100];
 FSFreeText* freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [freetext setFlags:4];
 // Set default appearance
 unsigned int da_flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 FSFont* da_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelveticaI];
 FSDefaultAppearance* default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:da_flags font:da_font text_size:12.0 text_color:0x000000];
 // Set default appearance for form.
 [freetext setDefaultAppearance:default_ap];
 [freetext setContent:@"A text box annotation."];
 [freetext setSubject:@"Textbox"];
 [freetext setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [freetext setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 FSRichTextStyle* richtext_style = [[FSRichTextStyle alloc] init];
 FSFont* rcstyle_font_1 = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Times New Roman" styles:0 charset:FSFontCharsetANSI weight:0];
 [richtext_style setFont:rcstyle_font_1];
 [richtext_style setText_color:0xFF0000];
 [richtext_style setText_size:10];
 [freetext addRichText:@"Textbox annotation " style:richtext_style];

 [richtext_style setText_color:0x00FF00];
 [richtext_style setIs_underline:YES];
 [freetext addRichText:@"1-underline " style:richtext_style];

 [richtext_style setIs_underline:NO];
 [richtext_style setText_color:0x0000FF];
 [richtext_style setIs_strikethrough:YES];
 FSFont* rcstyle_font_2 = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Calibri" styles:0 charset:FSFontCharsetANSI weight:0];
 [richtext_style setFont:rcstyle_font_2];
 int rc_count = [freetext getRichTextCount];
 [freetext insertRichText:(rc_count-1) content:@"2_strikethrough " style:richtext_style];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a text box freetext annotation with richtext.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add note annotation
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:10 bottom1:350 right1:50 top1:400];
 FSNote* note = [[FSNote alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotNote rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [note setFlags:4];
 [note setIconName:@"Comment"];
 [note setSubject:@"Note"];
 [note setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 [note setContent:@"Note annotation."];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [note setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [note setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [note setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Add popup to note annotation
 annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:300 bottom1:450 right1:500 top1:550];
 FSPopup* popup = [[FSPopup alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotPopup rect:annot_rect]];
 [popup setBorderColor:0x00FF00];
 [popup setOpenStatus:NO];
 local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [popup setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [note setPopup:popup];

 // Add reply annotation to note annotation
 FSNote* reply = [note addReply];
 [reply setContent:@"reply"];
 local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [reply setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [reply setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 [reply setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 // Add state annotation to note annotation
 FSNote* state = [note addStateAnnot:@"Foxit SDK" model:FSMarkupStateModelReview state:FSMarkupStateAccepted];
 [state setContent:@"Accepted set by Foxit SDK"];
 [state setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [note resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a note annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a link annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add link annotation
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:350 bottom1:350 right1:380 top1:400];
 FSLink* link = [[FSLink alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotLink rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [link setFlags:4];
 [link setHighlightingMode:FSAnnotHighlightingPush];

 // Add action for link annotation
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [page getDocument];
 FSURIAction* action = [[FSURIAction alloc] initWithAction:[FSAction create:doc action_type:FSActionTypeURI]];
 [action setTrackPositionFlag:YES];
 [action setURI:@"www.foxitsoftware.com"];
 [link setAction:action];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [link resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a link annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a caret annotation

NSString* key = @"";

 time_t t = time(NULL);

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {

 break;

 break;
 default:

 break;

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library

 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add caret annotation.
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:400 bottom1:450 right1:420 top1:470];
 FSCaret* caret = [[FSCaret alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotCaret rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [caret setFlags:4];
 FSRectF* inner_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:410 bottom1:450 right1:430 top1:470];
 [caret setInnerRect:inner_rect];
 [caret setContent:@"Caret annotation"];
 [caret setSubject:@"Caret"];
 [caret setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];

 }

 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a ink annotation

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add ink annotation
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100 bottom1:350 right1:200 top1:450];
 FSInk* ink = [[FSInk alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotInk rect:annot_rect]];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 [ink setFlags:4];
 FSPath* inklist = [FSPath new];
 float width = 100;
 float height = 100;
 float out_width = MIN(width, height) * 2 / 3.f;
 float inner_width = out_width * sin(18.f / 180.f * 3.14f) / sin(36.f / 180.f * 3.14f);
 FSPointF* center = [FSPointF new];
 [center set:150 y:400];
 float x = out_width;
 float y = 0;
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:(center.x + x) y:(center.y + y)];
 [inklist moveTo:point];
 for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
 x = out_width * cos(72.f * i / 180.f * 3.14f);
 y = out_width * sin(72.f * i / 180.f * 3.14f);
 [point set:(center.x + x) y:(center.y + y)];
 [inklist lineTo:point];

 x = inner_width * cos((72.f * i + 36) / 180.f * 3.14f);
 y = inner_width * sin((72.f * i + 36) / 180.f * 3.14f);
 [point set:(center.x + x) y:(center.y + y)];
 [inklist lineTo:point];
 }
 [point set:(center.x + out_width) y:(center.y + 0)];
 [inklist lineTo:point];
 [inklist closeFigure];
 [ink setInkList:inklist];
 [ink setSubject:@"Ink"];
 [ink setTitle:@"Foxit SDK"];
 [ink setContent:@"Note annotation."];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [ink setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [ink setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [ink setUniqueID:randomUID()];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [ink resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add an ink annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get attributes of viewer preference and values of metadata in a PDF file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

NSString *kMetadataItems[8] = {@"Title", @"Author", @"Subject", @"Keywords", @"Creator", @"Producer", @"CreationDate", @"ModDate"};

void ShowMetaDataInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
 FSMetadata *metadata = [[FSMetadata alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kMetadataItems) / sizeof(kMetadataItems[0]); i++) {
 NSString *item = kMetadataItems[i];
 NSArray<NSString *> *value = [metadata getValues:item];
 }
}

const FSPDFDocDisplayMode kDisplayModes[6] = {FSPDFDocDisplayUseNone, FSPDFDocDisplayUseOutlines, FSPDFDocDisplayUseThumbs, FSPDFDocDisplayFullScreen, FSPDFDocDisplayUseOC, FSPDFDocDisplayUseAttachment};

NSString *kDisplayModeStrings[6] = {@"UseNone", @"UseOutlines", @"UseThumbs", @"FullScreen", @"UseOC", @"UseAttachment"};

NSString *GetViewerPrefPrintScaleName(FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScale ui_item) {
 switch (ui_item) {
 case FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScaleNone:
 return @"PrintScaleNone";
 case FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScaleAppDefault:
 return @"PrintScaleAppDefault";
 default:
 return @"";
 }
}

void ShowDocViewerPrefsInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
 content = @"";
 FSDocViewerPrefs *prefs = [[FSDocViewerPrefs alloc] initWithDocument:doc pdf_dict:NULL];

 // Get display mode for non full-screen mode.
 FSPDFDocDisplayMode mode = prefs.nonFullScreenPageMode;
 NSString *display_mode = @"";
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kDisplayModes) / sizeof(kDisplayModes[i]); i++) {
 if (mode == kDisplayModes[i]) {
 display_mode = kDisplayModeStrings[i];
 break;
 }
 }

 // Get reading direction.
 bool is_rtl = prefs.readingDirection;

 // Get the type of area item.
 FSPDFPageBoxType type = prefs.printClip;

 // Get page scaling option.
 GetViewerPrefPrintScaleName(prefs.printScale)

 // Get the number of copies to be printed.
 int copy = prefs.printCopies
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@", input_path, @"AboutFoxit.pdf"];
 NSFileManager *fileManager = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
 BOOL isDir = NO;
 if ([fileManager fileExistsAtPath:output_directory isDirectory:&isDir]) {
 if (!isDir) {
 NSError *error = nil;
 if (![fileManager removeItemAtPath:output_directory error:&error] || error) {
 return -1;
 }
 if (![fileManager createDirectoryAtPath:output_directory withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:&error] || error) {
 return -1;
 }
 }
 } else {
 NSError *error = nil;
 if (![fileManager createDirectoryAtPath:output_directory withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:&error] || error) {
 return -1;
 }
 }

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld\n", input_file, errorCode);
 return 1;
 }
 // Show original information.
 ShowDocViewerPrefsInfo(doc, @"original.txt");
 ShowMetaDataInfo(doc, @"original.txt");
 NSString *output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@", output_directory, @"AboutFoxit_docinfo.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add a freetext annotation with richtext as call-out.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* r = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;

 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(r->tm_year + 1900) month:(r->tm_mon + 1) day:(r->tm_mday) hour:(r->tm_hour) minute:(r->tm_min) second:(r->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";

 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];

 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

	@autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 @try {

 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"annotation_input.pdf";
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 // Get first page with index 0
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];

 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:300 bottom1:50 right1:400 top1:100];
 FSFreeText* freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:annot_rect]];
 [freetext setFlags:4];
 unsigned int da_flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 FSFont* da_font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelveticaB];
 FSDefaultAppearance* default_ap = [[FSDefaultAppearance alloc] initWithFlags:da_flags font:da_font text_size:12.0 text_color:0x000000];
 [freetext setDefaultAppearance:default_ap];
 [freetext setIntent:@"FreeTextCallout"];
 FSPointFArray* callout_points = [FSPointFArray new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:250 y:60];
 [callout_points add:point];
 [point set:280 y:80];
 [callout_points add:point];
 [point set:300 y:80];
 [callout_points add:point];
 [freetext setCalloutLinePoints:callout_points];
 [freetext setCalloutLineEndingStyle:FSMarkupEndingStyleOpenArrow];

 [freetext setContent:@"A callout"];
 [freetext setSubject:@"Callout"];
 [freetext setTitle:@"SDK"];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [freetext setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [freetext setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 FSRichTextStyle* richtext_style = [[FSRichTextStyle alloc] init];
 FSFont* rcstyle_font_1 = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Times New Roman" styles:0 charset:FSFontCharsetANSI weight:0];
 [richtext_style setFont:rcstyle_font_1];
 [richtext_style setText_color:0xFF0000];
 [richtext_style setText_size:10];
 [freetext addRichText:@"Callout " style:richtext_style];

 [richtext_style setText_color:0x00FF00];
 [richtext_style setIs_underline:YES];
 [freetext addRichText:@"1-underline " style:richtext_style];

 [richtext_style setIs_underline:NO];
 [richtext_style setText_color:0x0000FF];
 [richtext_style setIs_strikethrough:YES];
 FSFont* rcstyle_font_2 = [[FSFont alloc] initWithName:@"Calibri" styles:0 charset:FSFontCharsetANSI weight:0];
 [richtext_style setFont:rcstyle_font_2];
 int rc_count = [freetext getRichTextCount];
 [freetext insertRichText:(rc_count-1) content:@"2_strikethrough " style:richtext_style];
 // Appearance should be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];

 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"annotation.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 return 1;
 }
 return 0;
	}
}
